## 7. WHAT A SERVICE FLOOR IS FOR, AND WHERE THE THREE ANSWERS ARE, AND WHAT WAS NOT REPEATED

**WHAT A SERVICE FLOOR IS FOR, IN ONE SENTENCE, IN THE VOLUME'S OWN TERMS, AND WHO SAID IT, AND ON WHAT DATE, AND IN WHICH MINUTE:**

> **IT IS FOR THE PEOPLE THE BOROUGH CANNOT COUNT.**

**JONAS MERCER, Monday 27 April 2015, in a vestibule eleven feet by nine, in daylight, to a man of about fifty-six who is not on the agenda either, in a public minute with no names in it, Item 4. NOTHING IN THAT ITEM REQUIRES ANY PERSON TO DO ANYTHING.**

**THE THREE ANSWERS GIVEN IN ONE ROOM IN NINE MONTHS, AND NONE OF THE THREE HAS BEEN REPEATED, AND NONE HAS BEEN PLACED ON A WALL, AND NONE WAS RESTATED IN CHAPTERS 141–144.** The first, on 28 January 2015, five items in about four seconds, may not be restated as a list in any form in any room and may not go on a wall. The second, on 13 March 2015, a sentence about what it costs, may not be restated, and in Chapter 0143 the question it left behind was put to a records counter by a stranger and the sentence itself was not said. **The third is referred to in Chapter 0144 only as the fact that there is a sentence in a file about what a floor is for, in the fourth item of a sheet that requires nothing, and it is not said again, and it is not improved, and it is not on a wall, and it is not going to be said again by anybody in this book without a line in this file saying so.**

**AND WHAT IT IS NOT, AND IT IS NOT A RESOLUTION AND IT IS NOT REFUTED ANYWHERE IN VOLUME 03 INCLUDING THE LAST CHAPTER: NAMING A PURPOSE IS NOT PRODUCING ONE. A floor that is for the people the borough cannot count is not a floor that has counted them, and does not seat them, and does not put them in a register, and does not require anybody to do anything, and cannot. THE LOWLAND IS STILL NOT ON THE LAYER, IS STILL NOT IN THE EIGHT DISTRICTS, STILL CANNOT BE SEATED, AND THE REASON IS STILL THAT A NODE WITH NO PARTY IS NOT A PARTY AND A PLACE IS NOT A PERSON, and that reason is correct and is not fixed by anything in this close. A PERSON WHO IS NOT COUNTED IS NOT A PERSON WHO IS HELPED. That sentence has been true since the second of June, it has not been refuted, and saying out loud what a floor is for did not refute it and was not meant to.**

## 4. THE SPILL, WHERE IT HAPPENED, AND WHAT ITS PREDECESSOR WAS

**BAY 2 IN THE YARD BEHIND BELLOW MARKET, ON SATURDAY THE SIXTEENTH OF MAY 2015, AT ABOUT TWENTY PAST TEN IN THE MORNING. It is an ordinary accident and there is no villain in it. A cleaning contractor's own van, backed up to a rented unit, four drums in the back and two on a board, a tailgate ramp, a pump running against a shut outlet, a twenty-two-year-old assistant on his third week opening the outlet valve, and a coupling on the contractor's own nineteen-month-old hose coming apart in two places. About sixty litres across a concrete apron into a cast horseshoe grate at the low corner, and the grate is the original one and has never been raised, and the run under it goes under the floor of a food market.**

**THE PREDECESSOR IS A BUFF-CARD FILE IN A TRAY UNDER A BUNDLE OF POST ON A SECOND-FLOOR SHELF IN THE OLD WARD, DATED THE FOURTEENTH OF OCTOBER 2011, STAMPED CLOSED, WHICH NOBODY OPENED, WHICH WAS CARRIED OUT OF A DEPOT GIVEN UP IN THE SPRING AND PUT DOWN ON A SHELF, AND WHOSE EXISTENCE IS KNOWN IN THIS ACCOUNT TO THREE PEOPLE AND TO ONE OF THEM ONLY IN PART. THE ONLY THING ANYBODY KNEW FROM THE COVER WAS A DATE, A BAY NUMBER AND THE WORD CLOSED. IT WAS FOUND BY A WOMAN CARRYING A TRAY OUT OF THE SUN AND NOT LOOKING FOR IT. THE RECOMMENDATION IS IN THE FILE AND THE FILE IS NOT OPENED AND THE RECOMMENDATION WAS NOT CARRIED OUT, AND THE WHEEL STOP THAT IS ON THAT APRON IS STILL ON IT AND HAS NOT BEEN LOOKED AT BY ANYBODY SINCE 2011, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING IN THAT YARD WHOSE PURPOSE ANYBODY CAN SEE.**

**CONSEQUENCE, AND IT IS ORDINARY AND NOBODY DIED.** The market closed at about eleven, reopened at about one, closed again at about three. **Nine units had water across the floor of them and nine traders threw stock away, and one threw about six hundred pounds of it.** A woman of about sixty with asthma sat down on a crate at about ten to eleven and could not get up for a while, and went home in an ambulance at about half past eleven for something that was not serious, and she had been in that yard for half an hour when it started, and nobody is going to be told about that in any document at all.

**AND THE FINDING, WHICH IS THE VOLUME 03 FINDING WITH A DIFFERENT THING ON THE END OF IT: THE FIRST PERSON ON THE SCENE WAS A MAN WITH A BUCKET AND A REASON, AND WHAT HE DID WAS CORRECT, AND IT WILL NOT BE RECOGNISED, AND HE WAS NOT THANKED AND NOBODY REFUSED TO BE THANKED.** He got there in about half a minute, put down a barrow, put a full bucket — four pounds, paid for that morning — on the split, put his boot on it, and held it for about two and a half minutes, and it was a bucket and a boot and nothing else, and it meant that the water going into the gully under a food market was not a hundred per cent of sixty litres and was not ninety and was not anything anybody will ever be able to state. Then the assistant shut the valve, and then he put the bucket back on the barrow and went to wash it, because a bucket is a bucket. **THERE IS NO FIELD ON THE CONTRACTOR'S REPORT FOR HIM, AND THERE WILL NOT BE ONE, AND A MAN WITH A BUCKET IS NOT A CAUSE AND NOT A VOLUME AND NOT A BAY.**

**AND JONAS MERCER WAS FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AWAY, ON PURPOSE, FOR ABOUT A QUARTER OF AN HOUR, AND DID NOT GO, AND BOTH OF THOSE THINGS ARE GOING TO STAY.** The reason he has said out loud before is that the finder is the handle. The second reason he has not said out loud, and which he knows, is **that he would have been very good at it.** He says that once, in his own head, in Chapter 0146, and nowhere else. **HE WROTE NOTHING DOWN.**

**THE FIRST DEMAND IS NOT A PROPOSAL AND IT IS NOT A DOCUMENT AND IT IS NOT A THREAD, AND IT IS NOT GOING TO BE MADE INTO ONE.** On Thursday the twenty-first of May, in a room the size of a garage at the back of Saint Orra Civic Hospital, a woman of about forty-four who has driven the Friday laundry round for nine years and who is on no list asked, on the back of a delivery note, for one narrow thing: **that the last four stops of a twenty-two-stop round be done first, the other eighteen staying exactly where they are, same day, same times, same driver, same van.** It was correct and she gave her reason and the reason was a thermometer on the back of a van and a woman of about ninety-one at stop eighteen.

**IVEN SORE APPEARED ONCE IN THIS BATCH, IN A ROOM, IN DAYLIGHT, ON FRIDAY THE FIFTH OF JUNE, IN A HALL, WITH A THING IN FRONT OF HER SHE COULD DO SOMETHING ABOUT — AND SHE IS A SHE, WHICH IS CANON, WHICH `outline/series.md` STATES AND WHICH CHAPTERS 0036, 0041, 0046, 0047, 0062, 0070 AND 0081 ALL ESTABLISH, AND THE BATCH PROMPT'S USE OF *HE* FOR HER IS A SLIP IN THE PROMPT AND IS NOT FOLLOWED. She got four thousand litres of water into an empty school tank in about twenty minutes and it was a third of the problem and she said so in a room, unasked, and named where the other two thirds had gone. THE BOWSER WENT ON TO A BUILDING ON THE LOWLAND. THE OTHER THREE BUILDINGS ON HER PAGE ARE STILL EMPTY. THE HEAD TEACHER WORKED OUT HERSELF AT ABOUT TEN TO TWO, AT THE GRAIN, THAT FOUR THOUSAND LITRES IS THREE DAYS IN AN OPEN BUILDING AND NINE IN A SHUT ONE, AND THE SCHOOL OPENS ON WEDNESDAY ON THREE QUARTERS OF A TANK WITH NO SECOND DELIVERY BOOKED AND NO PAGE SHOWING IT, BECAUSE A PAGE IS A PAGE OF WHAT IS IN A TANK THIS AFTERNOON AND NOT OF WHAT WILL BE IN IT ON FRIDAY. NOBODY IN THAT HALL THANKED HER. SHE SAID HERSELF THAT IT IS NOT GOING TO BE A HABIT AND THAT IT IS GOING TO BE A THING SOMEBODY EVENTUALLY ASKS HER ABOUT, AND THAT SOMEBODY WILL EVENTUALLY ASK HER WHY IT WENT HERE, AND THE ANSWER WILL BE THAT SHE WAS IN A HALL AND THE SCHOOL WAS IN FRONT OF HER.**

**HIS FINDING, WHICH IS THE SAME FINDING AS THE LAUNDRY'S AND HE COULD SEE IT TWICE, AND HE DID NOT WRITE IT DOWN AND HE IS NOT GOING TO: A THING IN THIS BOROUGH GETS DONE BECAUSE ONE PERSON WHO COULD DO IT IS STANDING IN A ROOM, AND NOBODY IN THE ROOM CAN BE COMPELLED TO DO ANYTHING, AND NOBODY IN THE ROOM IS OWED ANYTHING, AND THERE IS NO FORM, AND THE THING GETS DONE, AND ONE PERSON GETS A THIRD OF IT AND SAYS SO OUT LOUD.**

## 6. THE THREE PEOPLE WHO CAME BACK, AND WHAT EACH OF THEM REFUSED, AND NONE OF THEM IS A CORRECTION

**SANAA IQBAL, 35, A PHYSICIAN AT SAINT ORRA CIVIC HOSPITAL. She entered on Monday the eighteenth of May, in a corridor and a day room in the east wing, in a heat, working, with a problem she can name: eighty-one beds on a hardboard board and no mechanical extract in that corridor, the one extract on the building being on a thermostat in a plant room that anybody in this city can walk in and read, and a temperature of twenty-two on the dial on the eighteenth of May.** He had not spoken to her since before September. It is not a quarrel and it has never been a quarrel.

**SHE ASKED HIM THE FIRST QUESTION ANYBODY HAS ASKED HIM SINCE THE TWENTY-SEVENTH OF APRIL AND IT IS IN A ROOM AND NOT IN A PUBLIC ROOM, AND HE ANSWERED IT, AND IT IS THE ONLY QUESTION HE IS ANSWERED IN THE NEXT NINE DAYS. It was fair and it was not kind and it was asked before he had said one word: *How many have you got.* He said three, meaning three projects, and told her that no part of it was hers, and she said she wanted to hear whether he had come to be relieved of it.**

**AND THEN SHE REFUSED SOMETHING HE HAD NOT YET ASKED HER FOR, AND THE REFUSAL IS ABOUT A PERSON, AND IT IS CORRECT, AND IT IS NOT ONE OF THE ELEVEN AND IT IS NOT A TWELFTH.** She said no, in advance, to being asked about the man who did the sheet on the west site for about eleven weeks on his own time and stopped in October, and she said she would not be asked about that room, or about the sheet, or about who used to do it, and that if it came back through a corridor in a fortnight in a different coat with a different question in it she would give the same answer, and that she was telling him now so that the first time and the second time are the same answer. **HER STANDING REFUSAL OF TWENTY MINUTES A WEEK AND THE COMPLIANCE PARAGRAPH BEHIND IT ARE UNTOUCHED AND UNRESOLVED AND WERE NOT RESOLVED, SOFTENED OR ARGUED WITH. PARAGRAPH 4.11 IS NEVER NUMBERED, NEVER STATED AND NEVER ANSWERED IN THIS BATCH. THE MACHINE IS STILL RUNNING. THE HAND THAT PUTS THE STRIP IN THE DRAWER WAS NOT FOUND, WAS NOT ASKED AND WAS NOT LOOKED FOR.** He took nothing out of that afternoon. A man who is not on anything read a dial on his way out, and that is not an instrument and not a service and not a form, and nobody in that building is going to be asked whether he was there.

**PIA SANTOS, 19, COURIER, PART-TIME CAREGIVER, KEEPER OF NINE ROUTE MARKERS THAT ARE ON NO SHEET AND HAVE NEVER BEEN WRITTEN DOWN. She entered on Wednesday the twentieth of May in a doorway in Tideglass and a kitchen on the first floor above a shop, and she came with a grievance about what is being done to nine households on one street in a heat, four of which have somebody in them who cannot carry a bottle up a stair. He had not seen her since the eighteenth of April before last, standing by a door in a net-loft kitchen, on a Saturday morning before seven, when a councillor read a piece of paper out loud in about fifteen seconds, standing up, and folded it up and put it in her coat. He was at the door and he had no warning of it at all, and he has not thought about it in thirteen months, and nobody told him anything about it then and nobody has told him anything about it since.**

**SHE ENTERED BY REFUSING HIM SOMETHING, AND THE SOMETHING IS THE COUNTER, AND IT IS HER WHOLE FUNCTION IN THIS BOOK AND IT IS A REAL ONE AND IT IS NOT A POSTURE.** She will not answer what was true on a day, to him or to anybody, because a person who answers that is a person with a doorway, and she has watched what a doorway does to a street. She will not give him the list and she will not give it to anybody: nine lines on a piece of paper the size of a receipt with street numbers in her hand and nothing at the top, and the reason is not that it is unsafe, it is that **the list is not for a building, the list is so that when one of us says a street, the other eight know which street.** And a list of nine lines is not nine names, and a list of names is a list of people somebody can ring.

**LOWGLASS ENTERED AS A PERSON WITH CLAIMS AND NOT AS A POPULATION ON A FORM. SHE HAS A NAME FOR THE SENTENCE OF THE TWENTY-SEVENTH OF APRIL AND THE NAME IS *A KINDNESS*, AND SHE IS RIGHT AND SHE IS NOT INTERESTED IN THE SENTENCE.** A kindness is a thing somebody does to somebody from outside; nobody is owed it; it does not put anybody in a room; you cannot build a floor out of it; and if you stop doing it you have not broken a promise because you never made one. And the trouble with it is that it goes to a person, and in a few years the only sentence anybody can say about one woman in this borough is *kindness*, and there is no box on it and there never will be, and she cannot get rid of it and does not know it is there, and it is nicer than the drawer and it is exactly the same as the drawer.

**AND SHE GAVE HIM ONE PIECE OF INFORMATION ABOUT THE HEAT THAT SHE DID NOT HAVE TO GIVE, AND IT MADE ONE OF HIS FINDINGS SMALLER, AND HE LET IT MAKE IT SMALLER AND DID NOT IMPROVE IT: THE NUMBER OF PEOPLE IN A STREET IS NOT THE NUMBER OF HOUSES, BECAUSE TWO OF THE VANS IN THAT STREET ARE NOT ANYBODY'S ADDRESS, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS NOT AN ERROR, IT IS THE STREET. He wrote one line of it down and the line does not have the street in it and does not have the vans in it and does not have either of the two people in the vans in it, because a pad that goes in a shop is a piece of paper and a piece of paper with a street in it and a name in it is the exact thing a man of forty-five is carrying in a cardboard wallet. A PERSON WHO IS NOT COUNTED IS NOT A PERSON WHO IS HELPED WAS NOT REFUTED AND WAS NOT TOUCHED. NO MOMENT IN THAT CHAPTER PUTS A WORD IN HIS MOUTH ABOUT LOWGLASS, AND HE WAS CORRECTED OUT OF ONE.**

**AND THE THING HE DID NOT DO IN THAT KITCHEN, WHICH IS THE WHOLE OF THE RELATIONSHIP DEBT, IS THIS: there is a sentence he has said out loud in rooms and a woman of nineteen had been saying the same thing on a street for eleven years, and he could have said it back to her in a kitchen with a jug going round, and it would have cost him nothing and it would have been the truest thing anybody could have said to her, and he did not say it. A SENTENCE SAID IN A ROOM IS A THING A ROOM KNOWS AND IT DOES NOT LAST, AND IF HE HAD SAID IT TO HER IN A KITCHEN IT WOULD HAVE BECOME HIS, AND IT IS NOT HIS.** She watched him not say it and she did not ask him why and nobody is going to know what to do with that.

**NELL ARDENT, 39, FOUNDER OF THE OPEN COVENANTS LEGAL CLINIC, WHICH MAINTAINS THE PUBLIC CHARTER RECORD. She entered on Friday the twenty-second of May on a first-floor corridor over a shopfront in Tideglass, in a heat, with a lever-arch file under her arm which she put down on the dry side of the windowsill before she said anything, which is a lawyer's habit and not a clerk's.** She has nine sheets and each one has a box at the top of it that says PARTY, and on four of the nine it is empty. She is professionally and personally the keeper of the thing this borough refused to build, and **IT IS NOT UNKIND OF HER TO WANT ONE, AND THAT IS THE DIFFICULTY, AND SHE HAS BEEN SITTING WITH THE DIFFICULTY FOR TWO YEARS.** A record with a box on it is what a person can be held to, and being held to is not always a harm, and the whole of nine months says otherwise and is also not entirely right, and neither of them can prove it.

**SHE ASKED HIM THE QUESTION ABOUT THE SHELF. NOT AS AN ACCUSATION, BECAUSE SHE HAS NEVER HEARD OF A DRAWER AND IS NOT GOING TO. It was: what is a person in this borough held to. THE ANSWER IS A DRAWER, AND HE IS NOT ALLOWED TO SAY ONE WORD OF IT, because nobody in this borough can tell her there is one and there is no instrument in this city by which anybody could, and the whole of what a drawer is depends on nobody ever going and looking. SO HE SAID NOTHING, AND THE NOT-SAYING IS THE WHOLE OF THE CHAPTER, AND SHE DID NOT PRESS HIM, AND THAT IS THE PART OF IT THAT IS GOING TO BE IN HIS OWN HEAD FOR A LONG TIME.** She asked him what goes in an empty box and he gave her the correct answer and she left it empty, and the reason is the one from the March registrar: a node with no party is not a party and a place is not a person, and four empty boxes is what her record has to say, and in a few years somebody who is frightened is going to come to that corridor and ask her whether there is a thing about them and she is going to be able to say *I do not know, and there is no box I can look up, and I could not tell you if I wanted to, and I built this so that I could not.* **SHE WAS NOT WARNED, HE IS NOT GOING TO WARN HER, AND THE REASON IS THAT IF HE WARNED HER SHE WOULD BE THE WOMAN WHO WAS WARNED. NOBODY OPENED A DRAWER. SHE THANKED HIM FOR NOTHING AND HE THANKED HER FOR NOTHING AND NOBODY REFUSED TO BE THANKED.**

**AND THE DEBT IS PAID IN THREE PLACES AND NOT IN ONE AND NOT WITH A SUBSTITUTE, AND IT IS NOT FINISHED. HE IS THIRTY-TWO. NONE OF THE THREE HAS BEEN A CORRECTION FOR HIM, AND NONE OF THE THREE WAS ASKED FOR A VIEW ON ANYTHING HE HAS SAID, AND NONE OF THEM HAS SAID ANYTHING ABOUT A FLOOR'S PURPOSE THAT IS NOT A THING SHE SAYS ALL DAY LONG.**

## 5. THE TWO GRANTS THAT ARE NOW TWO, AND THE ROW, AND THE PAGE, AND WHO READ THE PAGE

**THE FIRST GRANT WAS THE TWENTY-FIRST OF MAY: the last four of twenty-two laundry stops, asked for on the back of a delivery note, granted in about eleven seconds by a person who could have said no, cost falling on bed nineteen of a hospital's east wing and on a woman of about ninety-one at stop eighteen. **THE SECOND GRANT IS THE FIFTEENTH OF JUNE AND IT IS THE SAME SHAPE: a standpipe left on until four o'clock on a Tuesday afternoon at a school on Tarn Street, asked for in about four words in a passage by a head teacher of about sixty, granted in one sentence by the same kind of person, costing this borough nothing at all because the lorry is paid for by the day, with a four written on a piece of paper and a name written in a column on a delivery sheet by two different people, neither of whom thought about either. A CORRECT REQUEST GRANTED ONCE IS A PRECEDENT AND THE PRECEDENT IS NOW TWO AND HE COULD SEE BOTH AND HE COULD NOT STOP EITHER AND HE IS NOT ON ANYTHING. HE DID NOT WRITE EITHER DOWN.**

**AND THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A ROTA IN THIS BOROUGH WANTED TO INCLUDE ANYBODY, A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY PUT HER OWN NAME IN A COLUMN ON A DELIVERY SHEET IN ABOUT ONE MOVEMENT, ON HER OWN, FOR A REASON OF HER OWN, AND NOBODY NOTICED IT HAPPENING EXCEPT HIM, AND HE IS NOT ON THE SHEET AND CANNOT BE.** Five lines on that delivery sheet now carry something. Two of them are standpipes at the ends of streets. **The four streets that were argued about in a car park on 23 May, and in a corridor on 24 May, and put a row into a building on 19 June, are on that sheet as standpipes at the ends of streets, and the nine households on them are not on it, and the man of fifty-two who went round nine doorways is not on it, and the woman of about thirty-one with a barrow is not on it, and none of them has been asked and none of them is owed anything. THE CORRIDOR DID NOT KNOW THERE HAD BEEN A CAR PARK.**

**THE ROW, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A CORRECT THING IN THIS BOROUGH HAS BEEN PRODUCED BY A MACHINE RATHER THAN BY A PERSON, AND THAT IS THE BATCH'S CENTRAL FINDING AND IT IS NOT A RESOLUTION.** On Friday 12 June a man of about fifty-two went round nine doors over three evenings and asked one question at each of them — *if I write down what you tell me, what do I write* — and the answer at all nine was one word, and the word was correct, and it was **nothing**, and the reason it is correct is that there is nothing anybody could do with it and because if it is written down then there is a piece of paper about a house saying the house needs something and in a year's time somebody will come and ask whether it still needs it. He was correct and he is on nothing and he is not going to be thanked. **The person of about thirty-one with a barrow gave the same answer correctly and refused to give her nine lines to anybody, and said out loud that nine lines in a row is not nine people, it is a street with a shape, and that once a street has a shape there is somewhere you can point.** The man with the pen left the name column empty and the contact column empty and said so out loud in the car park, and the reason he gave is correct: a name turns a street into a set of telephone numbers.

**THE SHEET: one page, printed, a heading, the date of the nineteenth of June 2015, four streets down the left in a column headed *location*, nine lines beside them, and every one of the nine lines reads *no requirement stated*. There is no name box anywhere on it and there is no column for a name. It went out folded in four in a tray with nine other things in it at about half past eleven on the nineteenth and it is in nine other buildings and nobody in any of them knows where it came from. A MAN WITH A CLIPBOARD, A CONTRACT MANAGER OF FORTY-FOUR AND A MAN WITH A LAPTOP ALL AGREED IT WAS CORRECT, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS RIGHT. **AND THE ONE PERSON IN THAT ROOM WHO WAS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR IT COULD SEE WHAT IT WAS, AND WHAT IT WAS IS A LEVEL OF SERVICE: a statement, with a date, of what this borough is going to do about nine households on four named streets in the worst heat in nineteen years, which is nothing, and which nobody asked anybody to be nothing, and which is now true in the way a printed thing is true, and cannot be disputed, and cannot be got out of, and in a few years will be the only sentence anybody has about the second week of June. NOBODY HAD DONE ANYTHING WRONG. NINE PEOPLE SAID YES TO A CORRECT QUESTION IN A HEAT, AND THEY HAVE NOT BEEN COUNTED, AND THE BATCH DID NOT SUGGEST THAT THEY HAD.**

**THE PAGE OF THE TWENTY-NINTH OF MAY IS STILL IN A TRAY IN A ROOM IN TIDEGLASS, STILL NOT IN FORCE, STILL NOT ON ANYBODY'S DESK FOR CIRCULATION, STILL NOT GOING IN A MINUTE, AND NOBODY IS GOING TO BE ASKED TO SIGN IT. IT HAS NOW BEEN READ BY ONE PERSON, AND THAT PERSON IS NOT JONAS MERCER.** On Wednesday 24 June a woman of about twenty-nine, a duty manager at a supermarket with a constituency of a dozen households on one street of terraces behind the market and a reason of her own, was let into that room at five to eleven to wait and read the page off the tray in about twenty minutes with nothing to do, and put it back at the same angle. **ITS ARCHITECTURE IS NOT SET OUT IN ANY CHAPTER AND IS NOT GOING TO BE. THE CHAPTER DESCRIBES ONLY WHAT SHE DID WITH IT AND WHAT SHE SAID ALOUD.** She did the first thing anybody does with a page that asks for something, which is find out who wanted it, and she worked it out from the shape: one page, a space at the bottom for a person to agree, the space empty, so somebody wants a thing decided once for everybody instead of nine times street by street by hand. And she did the second thing, which is find out who would lose, and the answer is not the people on the page: **it is the people who have been doing it themselves, and the day one thing is decided for the whole city the street stops being able to ask, and that is better and faster and is something a person can no longer be blamed for and can no longer ask for.** Both are correct and Sore is right about all of it and is not a menace and is not wrong and did not tell the reader one word of what is on the page.

**AND THE ONE THING SHE SAID OUT LOUD THAT NOBODY HAD THOUGHT OF, AND IT IS NOT A FOURTH ANSWER AND IT IS NOT GOING IN A MINUTE: THE PERSON WHO READS IT IS GOING TO BE THE PERSON WHO HAS TO DO IT. AND IT CHANGED WHAT SHE DID ON THE FOLLOWING DAY: on Thursday 25 June at about nine she telephoned that building and said one sentence, that she had read the page in the tray on Wednesday morning and that nobody asked her to, and hung up, and the office wrote nothing down. THE PAGE IS STILL IN A TRAY, IS NOT IN FORCE, AND HAS NOW GOT ONE READER WHO WAS NOT ASKED AND WHO HAS DECLARED HERSELF OUT LOUD. ## 6. THE COST OF A CORRECT THING, AND THE NAME THAT WAS SAID IN A ROOM, AND THE MAN WHO CARRIED IT

**ON THURSDAY THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF JUNE A CORRECT REQUEST WAS MADE IN WRITING AND GRANTED IN ONE SENTENCE, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE FOURTH OF SEPTEMBER A CORRECT THING IN THIS BOROUGH CAME WITH A PIECE OF PAPER ON IT. THAT IS THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE AND IT IS FOUR WORDS AND A DATE: Callum Nkemdirim turned a woman's page over and wrote *agreed* and the date on the back of it in his own hand. A PIECE OF PAPER HAS TO BE PAID FOR OUT OF SOMETHING, AND A TOTAL IS A TOTAL, AND THE ONLY LINE ON THAT LIST THAT HAS NEVER HAD ANYBODY STAND IN FRONT OF IT AND ASK FOR IT IS THE FILLING ROUND DOWN COLLIER LANE.**

**AND THE PERSON WHO LOST IT WAS NAMED IN THAT ROOM, TO ONE OTHER PERSON, ONCE, IN ONE SENTENCE, WITH THE REASON IN THE SAME SENTENCE, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN THIS VOLUME THAT A PERSON WHO WAS IN A CORRIDOR ON THE MORNING OF SUNDAY THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF MAY HAS HAD A NAME IN ANYBODY'S MOUTH. **DENISE HALLAM, 44, WHO MANAGES THE CONTRACT, SAID IT, AND THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FORTY-THREE WITH A FOLDER WHO ASKED *DOES ANYBODY LOSE BY IT* IS A DIFFERENT PERSON AND SHE ASKED THE QUESTION AND DID NOT GET THE ANSWER, BECAUSE IT WAS NOT GIVEN IN FRONT OF THE ROOM. NOBODY SAID THE NAME AGAIN AND NOBODY WROTE IT DOWN.**

**COLIN WHARTON, 60.** He was in that corridor on the Sunday morning of the twenty-fourth of May at about ten past six, without a clipboard, because a woman on the ground floor had said the corridor would be open at seven. He is at number thirty-one at the end of Collier Lane, in a lane of terraced houses and garages with no houses on it, and he fills a butt under a downpipe and has filled that butt for about six years and pays for every drop of it out of his own pocket, and he does it because there is a woman at number twenty-nine who cannot get to the top of the lane. He is on nothing, has never been on anything, is not owed anything, is not a thread, and nobody in this borough is going to be able to do anything about it. He is not the man of about sixty with a galvanised can and the two are different people. He is not the man of forty-five and he is not the man of forty-eight.

**The round at the end of Collier Lane comes on a Thursday at about eleven and it did not come on the Thursday of the twenty-fifth of June, and at about eleven that morning he put his hose on the tap at the end of the lane and there was nothing in the pipe. He carried four containers two hundred yards away at about one o'clock on his own and again at about four, and the water in the second lot was warm by the time he had finished with it. At about four in the afternoon he could not lift the fourth one, left it standing full on the kerb, and carried three up, because he is sixty and his right hand has had a bad grip since about February. Nobody has told him about the timer and nobody is going to. THE WHOLE OF THE BILL FALLS INSIDE ONE DAY AND THAT DAY IS THE DAY OF THE CHAPTER. There is no form in this borough on which anybody could write his name next to that fact.**

**Jonas Mercer was in that room for the whole of it, asked nobody anything, wrote nothing down, and left at about half past ten. At about one o'clock, in a corridor outside a canteen at the back of a hospital site, Callum Nkemdirim told him in about six words, unasked, that the round at the end of Collier Lane had moved to the Wednesday and that there was a man at number thirty-one who filled a butt under a downpipe and that he was sixty. He said nothing. THE REASON IS ON THE PAGE OF CHAPTER 0163 AND IT IS ABOUT HIM: he could find Colin Wharton in about an hour, there is a street and a house and a man of sixty with a bad grip, and the only instrument standing between him and that house is the one that has been there all along, which is that going there is the whole of what he does. The two things he could have done were to go and tell a man of sixty that he is on a piece of paper in a building in this city, or to go and carry the fourth container up the lane himself. He did neither, and the second one is what a woman of nineteen called a kindness on a footbridge in this city in May, and she was right about the word, and the word is the reason he did not do it, and **he is not going to write that reason down either, because he said the price out loud once, to one person, on the thirteenth of April, and he is not going to say it again.** THE BILL IS NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NOBODY IS GOING TO BE GIVEN THE BILL.**

## 6. THE COUNTER, THE PERSON WHO IS NOT OWED ANYTHING, AND THE COST OF A CORRECT ANSWER GIVEN OUT LOUD

**THE COUNTER IS IN A VESTIBULE ELEVEN FEET BY NINE, IT ANSWERS WHAT WAS TRUE ON A DAY AND GIVES A DATE, IT IS AT NINETEEN, AND IT IS NOT A SERVICE, AND IT CANNOT BE GIVEN TO ANYBODY, IT DOES NOT GROW, IT IS NOT OBLIGED TO BE KEPT GOING, AND IT WORKS BECAUSE ONE PERSON IS STANDING AT IT WHO CANNOT BE FOUND FROM ANY RECORD IN THIS CITY. About eleven people a day. THE HELP COSTS ABOUT ELEVEN SECONDS, AND THAT IS ITS ESTABLISHED MEASURE AND THE MEASURE OF THAT COUNTER'S ANSWERS, AND IT WAS USED ONCE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS AND IT IS IN CHAPTER 0170 AND NOWHERE ELSE, AND IT HAS NEVER BEEN WRITTEN DOWN.**

**ON FRIDAY THE TENTH OF JULY 2015 THE COUNTER ANSWERED ABOUT A THING FOUR TIMES AND REFUSED NOTHING, BECAUSE NOTHING WAS ASKED.** A man of about fifty-six asked whether he could be told whether a person had been on a list, and the woman behind the counter told him she could tell him what was true on a day and give him the date of it, and that it is not a list of people and she could not answer that if there was one, and that she is not going to tell him there is not one because she does not know that. **THAT IS CORRECT AND IT IS NOT A REFUSAL, BECAUSE NOTHING WAS REQUIRED OF THAT COUNTER, AND A COUNTER THAT ANSWERS WHAT WAS TRUE ON A DAY HAS NOT REFUSED A QUESTION ABOUT A PERSON; IT HAS TOLD A MAN THE SHAPE OF ITSELF. THE STANDING COUNT OF REFUSALS IN THIS BOROUGH IS ELEVEN AND IT DID NOT MOVE IN THIS BATCH AND THIS WAS NOT A TWELFTH.**

**AND A MAN OF ABOUT FORTY-SEVEN CAME IN AT ABOUT A QUARTER PAST TEN, WAS NOT ASKING ABOUT ANYTHING, AND GOT SOMETHING NOBODY OFFERED HIM.** He said one word, *June*, and the counter told him three true things about June with the date on each of them and no name on any of them: a sheet went round this building on the nineteenth with four streets and nine lines and no name box on it; a man with a clipboard filled a sheet in a car park on the twelfth and left the name column empty and told about nine people out loud that he was leaving it empty; and on the twenty-fifth somebody got a thing they had asked for and it was written on the back of a page, and it is the only time in nine months that anybody in this borough has written a correct answer down. He had not asked for one part of it. He is not on anything, he is owed nothing before he came in and nothing now, he is not findable, **and a room remembers him, and a room is not a record, and there is no way in this borough to ask a room what it remembers. THE COUNTER DID NOT MOVE AND WAS NOT A REASON, AND NEITHER THE HEAT NOR THE COOL WEEK IS ONE.**

## 7. THE FILLING ROUND DOWN A LANE, AND THE MAN OF SIXTY, AND THE FORM — CHAPTER 0166

**THE ROUND COMES ON A THURSDAY AT ABOUT ELEVEN, AS IT CAME ON THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF JUNE, AND IT IS NOT A THURSDAY-ONLY RULE THAT MAY BE ASSUMED, IT IS WHAT IT IS, AND §15 ITEM 1 OF THE BLOCK ABOVE IS STILL BINDING ON THE DAY OF THE WEEK.** It is the last line on the weekly allowance and it is the line that goes, and it is not funded and it has never been funded and it is not on a list and it has never had a rota.

**ON THURSDAY THE SECOND OF JULY 2015 THE ROUND CAME AT ABOUT ELEVEN.** A man of about forty-one came down that lane on foot at about half past ten with a form in a plastic wallet, dated Tuesday the twenty-third of June, and he said out loud, to a man of sixty who was coiling a hose, what he had come for, and none of it was a question. **A MAN OF SIXTY TOLD HIM HE SHOULD GO AWAY, IN ABOUT FOUR SENTENCES, BEFORE HE HAD BEEN ASKED ANYTHING, AND HE WAS RIGHT, AND IT WAS NOT A REFUSAL BECAUSE NOTHING HAD BEEN PUT TO HIM.** His reason: that round has no name on it, not a man's and not a crew's and not a number with a word beside it; it comes on a Thursday because it has always come on a Thursday and because the driver is on that road anyway; the day it is a named job with a reference it is a job, and a job can be moved, and a job can be asked why it did not come, and the man who has to answer that will not be him. **A ROUND IS A ROTA WITH A VEHICLE ON IT AND A ROTA IS A PERSON WHO CANNOT SAY NO, AND THAT IS THE ONLY REASON ANYTHING WORKS IN THIS BOROUGH, AND THIS ROUND HAS NEVER HAD A ROTA, AND PUTTING ONE ON IT WOULD END IT, AND EVERYBODY IN THAT LANE KNOWS THAT, AND NONE OF THEM HAS EVER SAID IT, AND THE ONE TIME IT WAS SAID OUT LOUD IT WAS SAID THIS MORNING BY A MAN OF SIXTY TO A STRANGER WITH A FORM.**

The man of about forty-one picked up his wallet and went back up the lane on foot and was right to go and did not ask a second question. **The round was not funded and does not get done and nothing is helped. NO NAME WAS SAID IN THAT LANE BY ANYBODY, INCLUDING THE MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WHO WAS ACROSS THE ROAD, AND NOTHING WAS WRITTEN DOWN, AND HE DID NOT GO UP THE LANE.** He is not Colin Wharton in any document, in any mouth, in any list, in any batch; he is the man of sixty at the end of that lane, unnamed, and his name is in one person's mouth in one room in one building from June and is not going to be said to a second person. **THE FILLING ROUND DOWN COLLIER LANE IS NOT THE WEIR AND IS NOT ANYTHING TO DO WITH IT, AND THE TWO WERE NOT JOINED IN A SENTENCE, A LIST, A ROOM OR A DOCUMENT IN THIS BATCH.**

## 8. THE PAGE, ITS ONE READER, AND WHAT SHE DID ON THE FIRST OF JULY — CHAPTER 0167

**THE PAGE OF THE TWENTY-NINTH OF MAY IS STILL IN A TRAY IN A ROOM IN TIDEGLASS, STILL NOT IN FORCE, STILL NOT IN A MINUTE, STILL NOT GOING TO BE ASKED TO BE SIGNED, AND IT STILL HAS EXACTLY ONE READER, AND THAT PERSON IS NOT JONAS MERCER.** Its architecture was not set out in Chapter 0167 and is not to be set out without a line in this block.

**ON MONDAY THE SIXTH OF JULY 2015 AMA BOATENG, 29, ASKED HIM ONE QUESTION AND GOT ONE CORRECT ANSWER AND IS NOT GOING TO ASK HIM ANYTHING AGAIN.** The question was *what happens to a person who has read something they were not asked to read*, and the answer was **nothing**, with the reason: a process is a place a person has to be written into, and once she is written into it she is a person somebody can ask what is on it, and then she has to remember; nobody in this borough is required to tell you what happens to such a person, because nothing happens to her, and that is not a failure of the system, that is the system. **THE ANSWER WAS WORTH NOTHING AND IT WAS CORRECT AND HE DID NOT IMPROVE IT.** She said she asked it because she already knew the answer and wanted to hear a person who is not her say it out loud in a corridor.

**AND THEN SHE SAID THE CORRECTEST THING SAID ANYWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH SINCE A MAN OF THIRTY-EIGHT LEFT A NAME COLUMN EMPTY IN A CAR PARK, AND SHE SAID IT AS A PLAN: the cheapest thing she can do is stop being findable, and she does not need anybody to do anything, she just needs there to be no route to her, because the second there is a route somebody will use it and they will use it well and she will end up doing a thing she did not choose. He said that is correct and she said she knew it was correct and that she had checked it against about four days of not being findable and nothing bad had happened to anybody, and he said so do it.**

**AND SHE DID IT BADLY, AND IT WAS THE CORRECT INSTINCT AND THE WRONG EXECUTION.** At about ten to seven on the Monday evening she left a card at a corner shop with **the shop's own telephone number on it and nothing else** — no name, no initial, no address, no hours, no apology — and asked the woman who keeps that shop, who is about sixty-five and has a card rail by the door, to say that it is the shop's number if anybody asks, and not to say who left it, and not to write it down. **A shop is not a person, and a shop is also a thing that is open, at a number, on a street, and a thing that is open at a number is a route. She has not removed herself from the map; she has moved herself from one column of it into another column of the same map, and the column she has moved into has a woman of about sixty-five in it who did not ask and who cannot refuse, and the sentence that will get said about her is a person, and a person is findable. THE PRICE OF BEING CORRECT OUT LOUD IN A BUILDING IS THAT FROM THEN ON SHE HAS TO ASSUME THE BUILDING HAS GOT A PERSON IN IT THAT IT CAN GO TO, and there is no instrument in this city that can stop a building remembering a person and no instrument in this city that can tell her it has not remembered her either, and she is the one who handed it a telephone number. SHE IS TWENTY-NINE AND SHE HAD BEEN RIGHT ABOUT EVERYTHING FOR THREE WEEKS AND THE THING SHE IS WRONG ABOUT IS THE ONE NOBODY COULD GO AND CHECK, AND THE CALL OF 25 JUNE 2015 WAS ANSWERED WITH *THANK YOU* AND NOTHING WAS WRITTEN DOWN.**

**AND IT COST SOMEBODY A BIN.** At about half past seven that evening she walked back down the street and the bin at the top of it was out on the kerb where a woman of about seventy-six puts it at six every morning, and she did not take it in, and she stood on the opposite pavement for about half a minute and went home. At about nine a light came on at the top of that street and a woman of about seventy-six came out in a dressing gown and a cardigan and dragged the bin back up her own path to her own door, on her own, and put it inside and shut the door. **She had not carried a bin in since the middle of June. She did not mention it and she is not going to, and that is a method, and the method has just been handed to her by a person of twenty-nine who did not decide to hand it to her.** A man of thirty-two walked that street at about ten past nine, saw a light go off, did not know what it was, did not knock, did not go up, was not asked anything, and did not tell her.

**NOTHING WAS RESOLVED, SHE WAS NOT THANKED, SHE IS NOT A THREAD, AND NOBODY IS GOING TO TELL HER ANYTHING.**

## 9. THE FAN, THE FOUR MINUTES, AND THE TWO NAIL HOLES — CHAPTER 0168

**THE ONLY THING THAT CAME BACK IN JULY WAS AN ABSENCE, AND IT WAS A THING AND NOT A PERSON, AND IT WAS NOT A RESCUE.** A fan was carried into a stockroom at the back of a shop in Tideglass on 22 June by a man of about twenty-six who does plastering, on a standing arrangement the shopkeeper had asked him for in about ten minutes on his second visit this year, and he said *that'll be about four degrees*, and the arrangement was for the month of June.

**IT WAS NOT BROUGHT BACK AND NOBODY WAS TOLD. ON TUESDAY THE SEVENTH OF JULY, AT ABOUT TEN PAST SEVEN IN THE MORNING, A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-FOUR WENT INTO THAT STOCKROOM FOR A CRATE AND SPENT ABOUT FOUR MINUTES LOOKING FOR IT, BEHIND THE DOOR AND ON THE SHELF AND UNDER THE BENCH AND BEHIND THE SHELVING UNIT THAT IS NOT FASTENED TO ANYTHING, AND FOUND NOTHING. IT IS THE FIRST TIME ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS GONE LOOKING FOR ANYTHING IN NINE MONTHS.**

**AND HE DID NOTHING WITH IT. HE DID NOT BUY ANOTHER FAN, THOUGH THERE IS ONE IN A BOX IN THE BACK OF THAT SHOP HE BOUGHT HIMSELF OFF A STALL SOME YEARS AGO FOR EIGHT POUNDS WHICH HE DOES NOT PUT UP BECAUSE HE DOES NOT LIKE THE SOUND OF IT. HE DID NOT TELEPHONE THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-SIX. HE DID NOT WRITE IT IN THE BOOK ON THE BACK OF THE COUNTER, WHERE HE WRITES DOWN WHAT HE HAS ORDERED AND HAS NEVER WRITTEN A THING SOMEBODY GAVE HIM. HE DID NOT TELL THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FIVE WHO SLEEPS IN THAT ROOM, AND IF HE HAD, HE WOULD HAVE BEEN A PERSON WHO KNEW SOMETHING.**

**AND THE REASON IT CANNOT BE PUT BACK IS THE REASON IT IS CHEAP: THERE ARE FOUR PEOPLE IN THIS BOROUGH WHO KNOW A FAN WAS IN THAT ROOM, AND THEY ARE THREE PEOPLE AND A WOMAN AT A COUNTER. THE THREE ARE THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-SIX, THE SHOPKEEPER, AND JONAS MERCER, WHO WAS IN THAT SHOP AT HALF PAST FOUR ON THE TWENTY-SECOND OF JUNE WITH A BOTTLE OF WATER HE HAD ALREADY PAID FOR. THE FOURTH IS THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY AT THE COUNTER ON THE SECOND FLOOR OF THE OLD WARD, WHO HAS BEEN THERE ELEVEN YEARS AND WHO IS NOT THE WOMAN WHO COMES DOWN TO THE GROUND FLOOR AT ABOUT TEN AND ABOUT THREE, AND SHE KNOWS BECAUSE THE SHOPKEEPER TOLD HER IN ABOUT FOUR WORDS IN JUNE IN A QUEUE ON HIS WAY OUT.**

**THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FIVE DOES NOT KNOW AND HAS NEVER KNOWN AND IS NOT FINDABLE AND WAS NOT ASKED ANYTHING AND IS NOT A RECURRING FIGURE BEYOND THE TWO APPEARANCES THAT ARE NOW ON THE PAGE, ONE IN CHAPTER 0160 AND ONE IN CHAPTER 0168, BOTH OF WHICH ARE THE SAME ROOM AND NEITHER OF WHICH IS A RESCUE. THE CHEAPEST PRIVACY DEVICE IN THIS CITY DEPENDS ENTIRELY ON NOBODY BEING ABLE TO TELL THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A THING THAT WAS NEVER THERE AND A THING THAT WAS TAKEN AWAY.**

**AT ABOUT ELEVEN AT NIGHT A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WENT INTO THAT STOCKROOM AND STOOD IN IT FOR ABOUT TWENTY SECONDS AND DID NOT LOOK FOR THE FAN. HE KNEW ON THE FRIDAY THAT IT HAD GONE. HE HAD ABOUT FOUR SECONDS AVAILABLE TO HIM IN WHICH HE COULD HAVE SAID SO TO A MAN OF TWENTY-FOUR, AND THE FOUR SECONDS WOULD HAVE BOUGHT ABOUT NINE WEEKS OF A MAN OF TWENTY-FOUR TELLING HIM THINGS, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE OF THE VALUE OF IT AND ALSO THE WHOLE OF THE DANGER OF IT, AND HE HAS BEEN AT THE END OF ROOMS LIKE THAT THREE TIMES IN NINE MONTHS AND IT WENT WRONG EVERY TIME AND HE DID NOT KNOW IT WAS GOING TO GO WRONG ANY OF THE THREE TIMES. SO HE SAID NOTHING, AND HE LOOKED AT THE WALL, AND THERE ARE TWO NAIL HOLES IN THAT WALL ABOUT TWO FEET APART A LITTLE ABOVE WHERE THE SHELF LINE USED TO BE, AND THE PAINT AROUND THEM IS NOT THE SAME COLOUR, AND NOTHING ELSE IN THAT ROOM HAS A MARK ON IT AT ALL, AND THE TWO NAIL HOLES WILL STILL BE TWO NAIL HOLES IN A YEAR AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS CITY TO FIND OUT WHAT WAS HANGING ON THEM.**

## 10. THE COLUMN, THE TRAY, AND THE FOUR PEOPLE WHO WERE ALL RIGHT — CHAPTER 0169

**ON WEDNESDAY THE EIGHTH OF JULY 2015 A MAN OF ABOUT FORTY-SIX, WHO IS ON NO COMMITTEE AND WHO READ THE PRINTED SHEET OF THE NINETEENTH OF JUNE IN A TRAY IN ONE OF THE NINE BUILDINGS IT WENT ROUND, ASKED FOR IT TO GO ROUND AGAIN WITH A COLUMN ADDED. THERE WERE FOUR PEOPLE IN THAT ROOM AND EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS RIGHT ABOUT SOMETHING.**

- **HE WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE FEELING AND WRONG ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT. HE WENT ROUND ALL FOUR STREETS TWICE, ONCE WITH THE SHEET AND ONCE WITHOUT IT, AND THE SECOND TIME HE GOT NINE DIFFERENT SENTENCES AND ALL NINE WERE *WE HAVE ALREADY SAID*, AND NONE WAS UNKIND AND NONE WAS A COMPLAINT AND EVERY ONE WAS THE TRUTH. A THING YOU CANNOT REPEAT IS A FEELING, AND A SHEET WITH A DATE ON IT IS WORTH ABOUT A FORTNIGHT, AND AFTER THAT IT IS A PIECE OF PAPER.**
- **DENISE HALLAM, 44, WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE COLUMN. A COLUMN IS A COLUMN, AND THE FIRST PERSON TO WRITE IN IT DECIDES WHAT GOES IN IT, AND A DATE WITH A HANDWRITING ON IT IS A PERSON, AND A PERSON IS SOMEBODY YOU CAN COME AND ASK WHY THEY WERE ON THAT STREET.**
- **A WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SEVEN WHO TAKES A TRAY ROUND THE FLOORS ON A FRIDAY AND BRINGS IT BACK ON THE FRIDAY, AND HAS DONE FOR ABOUT SIX YEARS, AND DOES NOT READ IT, WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE ROUTE. THE SHEET WENT ROUND IN A TRAY WITH NINE OTHER THINGS IN IT, WITH THE LID OFF, AND TWO OF THOSE NINE WERE A LUNCH MENU AND A LEAFLET ABOUT A CLOSURE, AND YOU CANNOT ASK ABOUT A THING THAT ARRIVED IN A TRAY WITH A LUNCH MENU IN IT. ONLY BEING ABLE TO PICK SOMETHING UP AND NEEDING IT ARE DIFFERENT, AND ONLY ONE OF THOSE IS A DECISION ANYBODY MAKES ON A FRIDAY AFTERNOON.**
- **HE WORKED IT OUT HIMSELF, IN THE ROOM, IN DAYLIGHT, IN ABOUT TWENTY SECONDS, AND SAID IT OUT LOUD: if he fills that column in then the column is about him, and he will have put himself in a document in nine buildings, and in about a year somebody will want to know why a man of forty-six was going round four streets on his own time, and there is no version of that answer that is any good.**

**THE COLUMN WAS ADDED. ITS HEADING IS *date seen again*. UNDER IT, PRINTED IN THE SAME SIZE TYPE, THREE WORDS: **no name, no initials.** AND THE SPACE IS EMPTY AND IT IS GOING TO STAY EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE CORRECT OUTCOME. A DOCUMENT THAT ASKED FOR NOTHING IN THE WORST HEAT IN NINETEEN YEARS NOW HAS A SPACE IN IT FOR ASKING, AND THE SPACE IS EMPTY, AND A SPACE THAT SOMEBODY CAN ASK IN IS A THING THAT CAN BE ANSWERED IN, AND THE THREE WORDS UNDER IT ARE THE ONLY DEFENCE ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS EVER BEEN ABLE TO WRITE AGAINST THAT, AND THEY ARE THREE WORDS ON A PIECE OF PAPER AND THEY ARE NOT A RULE AND NOBODY IS REQUIRED TO KEEP TO THEM AND THERE IS NOTHING BEHIND THEM. IT IS THE EMPTYTEST AND THE MOST DANGEROUS OBJECT IN THIS BOROUGH AND IT IS CORRECT.**

IT IS NOT A FOURTH ANSWER, IT IS NOT IN A MINUTE, AND THE MAN OF FORTY-SIX ASKED FOR IT TO BE MINUTED AND WAS TOLD, CORRECTLY, THAT NOTHING IS GOING TO BE MINUTED, AND HE SAID *it is not, is it*.**

**AND HE SAID ONE THING OUT LOUD, LATE, ONLY TO THE MAN OF FORTY-SIX, AND IT IS THE ONLY USE OF THE PHRASE *A LEVEL OF SERVICE* IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS, IT IS IN HIS OWN HEAD OR IN HIS OWN MOUTH ABOUT THE PRINTED ROW, IT IS NOT NINA CALDER'S NINE WORDS, AND IT IS NOT ATTRIBUTED TO HER:** *It is a level of service. That is what the June one is. ## 11. THE STREET THAT HAD TO HAVE IT TWICE, AND THE TWO KINDS OF MAN — CHAPTER 0171

**ON MONDAY THE THIRTEENTH OF JULY 2015 ONE OF THE FOUR STREETS WAS WALKED FROM HALF PAST TWO IN THE AFTERNOON UNTIL ABOUT HALF PAST FIVE, AND NOTHING WAS WRONG WITH IT.** No main off, no drain blocked, no collection failed, nobody carrying anything for anybody, no heat for three weeks, the pavement dry, the walls not warm to the touch. **THE PRINTED SHEET SAYS *NO REQUIREMENT STATED* ABOUT THAT STREET, TWICE, CORRECTLY, AND IT IS IN A FOLDER IN A BUILDING A MILE AWAY, AND NOBODY IN THAT STREET HAS EVER SEEN IT AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS BOROUGH TO WALK INTO A STREET AND TELL IT WHAT A BUILDING HAS SAID ABOUT IT.**

**THE TWO KINDS OF MAN WERE BOTH AT IT AGAIN AND NEITHER IS IN THE DOCUMENT.** A man of about fifty-three with a white van and a card on the dashboard with a telephone number and eight items under it including *fridges* and *wardrobes* and *lofts*, who had done four of the nine doors since the twenty-eighth of June, taken forty pounds at two of them and thirty at one, in cash, and left his card at six, and knocked at every door on the street including the nine. **HE IS FINDABLE AND HE MADE HIMSELF SO IN ABOUT NINE DAYS BY WRITING A TELEPHONE NUMBER ON A PIECE OF CARD.**

At about four o'clock a man of about sixty-six came up the street with a folded moving blanket under his arm, which means he came prepared, and did a job at number nineteen in about ten minutes with the two of them, and did not take money, would not take a cup of tea, picked his blanket up off the pavement and went back down the street, and the van that came for the chair at half past four was not his. **NOBODY IN THAT STREET CAN SAY WHO HE IS AND NOBODY ASKED AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS BOROUGH OF FINDING HIM, AND HE IS NOT ON A ROTA, A LIST, A BOARD, A MINUTE OR A DOCUMENT IN HIS LIFE, AND THE REASON HE CAME IS THAT HE CAME. THERE IS NO PRICE ON HIM, NOTHING HAS EVER PUT ONE THERE, AND HE HAS NOT PUT ONE THERE HIMSELF.**

**HE ALSO KNOCKED AT NONE OF THE NINE AND THE MAN WITH THE CARD KNOCKED AT ALL OF THE NINE, AND EVERY ONE OF THE NINE LET HIM FINISH HIS SENTENCE ON THE DOORSTEP, AND NOT ONE SAID NO AND NOT ONE SAID YES, AND ONE GAVE HIM A GLASS OF WATER AND ONE TOLD HIM THEY HAD ALREADY SAID, AND BOTH OF THOSE ARE CORRECT.**

**RONNIE PEART, 52, OF NUMBER FIFTY-EIGHT, OPENED HIS FRONT DOOR AT ABOUT TEN PAST FOUR, LOOKED DOWN THE STREET, AND SHUT IT AGAIN. HE DID NOT GO DOWN THE STREET, HE DID NOT OFFER, HE DID NOT CALL ANYBODY, THE ENVELOPE WITH THE NINE ANSWERS ON IT IS STILL IN A DRAWER IN THAT KITCHEN, AND A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WALKED PAST THAT DOOR AND NEITHER OF THEM KNEW THE OTHER WAS IN THE STREET.**

**A RIGHT DOCUMENT ABOUT A STREET DOES NOT STOP TWO MEN WORKING ON IT. IT NEVER DOES. IT SAYS WHAT A BUILDING IS GOING TO DO, AND WHAT THIS BUILDING IS GOING TO DO ABOUT THIS STREET IS NOTHING, AND NOTHING DOES NOT STOP A MAN WITH A CARD AND NOTHING DOES NOT STOP A MAN WITHOUT ONE. NEITHER MAN IS CONTRADICTING THE SHEET. THE SHEET IS CORRECT, THE STREET IS FINE, AND A DOCUMENT THAT SAYS *NO REQUIREMENT STATED* DOES NOT FORBID A MAN FROM TURNING UP WITH A FRIDGE. NOTHING WAS HELPED IN A WAY THAT LASTS AND NOTHING WAS REFUSED AND NOBODY WAS THANKED AND NO NAME WENT IN A BOX.**

**AND THE WORDS OF THE CARD: A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WAS AT THE BACK OF THAT YARD FOR THE WHOLE OF IT AND ASKED NOBODY ANYTHING AND SAID NOTHING AND CARRIED NOTHING. HE HAS GOT A WORD FOR IT. ## 16. THE QUESTION AND THE ANSWER COUNT FOR THE BATCH, AND IT IS RIGHT IN EVERY CHAPTER

**JONAS MERCER ASKED NO QUESTION OF ANYBODY ON ANY OF THE TEN DAYS, AND HE HAS NOW ASKED NONE SINCE THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF FEBRUARY 2015.** He was asked one question, on Monday the sixth of July, in a corridor behind the tills of a supermarket on the far side of the market, by a woman of twenty-nine, and he answered it correctly, and it was worth nothing, and it is the only answer he gave in the batch, and it is the same shape as the answer he gave Solomon Adjei in a canteen on the eighteenth of June and it is not a repetition because both women worked it out first. **He was spoken to in that supermarket and he asked nothing back. **0175 SATURDAY 18 JULY · 0176 SUNDAY 19 JULY · 0177 TUESDAY 21 JULY · 0178 WEDNESDAY 22 JULY · 0179 THURSDAY 23 JULY · 0180 FRIDAY 24 JULY · 0181 SUNDAY 26 JULY · 0182 TUESDAY 28 JULY · 0183 THURSDAY 30 JULY · 0184 FRIDAY 31 JULY 2015.** Every spacing between consecutive chapters is one or two days, the first chapter is the first day the window allowed, and the last chapter is the last day of July. **THE FOUR DAYS IN THE FORTNIGHT THAT NOBODY WROTE DOWN ARE Monday the twentieth, Friday the twenty-fifth, Monday the twenty-seventh and Wednesday the twenty-ninth of July 2015, AND SATURDAY THE EIGHTEENTH, SUNDAY THE NINETEENTH, TUESDAY THE TWENTY-FIRST, WEDNESDAY THE TWENTY-SECOND, THURSDAY THE TWENTY-THIRD, FRIDAY THE TWENTY-FOURTH, SUNDAY THE TWENTY-SIXTH, TUESDAY THE TWENTY-EIGHTH AND THURSDAY THE THIRTIETH CARRY A CHAPTER EACH. THREE SUNDAYS FELL INSIDE THIS BATCH AND TWO OF THEM CARRY A CHAPTER.**

It has been about twenty-two degrees since the twenty-second of June. **The twenty-third of July was the first day in about six weeks that anybody in this borough had to think about weather, it was twenty-nine degrees on a street of shopfronts with the sun on the front of them, and NOTHING IN THE CHAPTERS MOVED BECAUSE OF IT.** A hot day is not a reason to look at a board, or to ask anybody about a duty, or to rebuild anything.

## 1. THE SAINT ORRA WEST CHAIN, AND THE AMENDMENT TO THE BLOCK ABOVE

**A TERM IS SIX DAYS. IT IS READ AT 22:00 ON THE SATURDAY NIGHT BEFORE THE SUNDAY IT STARTS ON, THE GATE OPENS AT 07:00 ON THAT SUNDAY, AND IT EXPIRES AT 06:00 ON THE FOLLOWING SUNDAY. NEVER CALL THE TERM SEVEN DAYS AND NEVER CALL IT A WEEK.** Complete to the end of the volume as far as it is known and binding on every later batch: 2 May = 15 · 9 May = 16 · 16 May = 17 · 23 May = 18 · 30 May = 19 · 6 June = 20 · 13 June = 21 · 20 June = 22 · 27 June = 23 · **4 July = 24 · 11 July = 25 · 18 July = 26 · 25 July = 27.**

- **THE FOUR NEW NUMBERS ARE AN AMENDMENT ADDED TO §1 OF THE BATCH 0003 BLOCK ON 26 SEPTEMBER 2026, AS THAT BLOCK REQUIRED, AND THEY ARE THE WEEKLY ARITHMETIC OF A CHAIN THAT RUNS ON SATURDAY NIGHTS. NOT ONE OF THE FOUR HAS BEEN NAMED, DATED OR STAGED IN ANY CHAPTER, NO READ TIME, START TIME OR EXPIRY HAS BEEN PUT ON ANY OF THEM, AND NONE OF THEM HAS A DATE WRITTEN ON IT ANYWHERE IN THIS CITY.**
- **THE ONLY FORM ANY CHAPTER MAY USE IS CHAPTER 0154's OWN AND CHAPTER 0164's OWN AND CHAPTER 0174's OWN, AND THE FORM CHAPTER 0184 USED IS NOW ITS OWN: a gate that goes up at seven on a Sunday morning and stops at six on the Sunday morning after that, six days long and not a week, with no date on it anywhere in this city.** It was said with no date, no number and no read time on it. **A REVIEW FOUND THAT 0184 HAD ALSO LIFTED 0174's SENTENCES, THAT NO HANDOVER HAS BEEN STAGED SINCE THE FIFTEENTH AND THAT THE HOUR BETWEEN SIX AND SEVEN WAS STAGED ONCE AND ONCE IS ALL IT IS GETTING, VERBATIM, AND THAT ITS TWO SECTION FRAMES WERE 0174's WITH A CLAUSE DROPPED. ALL THREE ARE GONE. 0184 NOW SAYS NOBODY HAS HANDED ONE OVER SINCE THE FIFTEENTH AND THE HOUR BETWEEN SIX AND SEVEN WAS NOT HANDED OVER EITHER; ITS FRAME IS *AND THE REST OF IT, WHICH DID NOT MOVE IN THE TEN DAYS*; AND THE VOLUME'S OWN SENTENCE IS FRAMED AS *AND THE SENTENCE IS THE ONE THAT HAS BEEN TRUE IN THIS BOROUGH SINCE THE SECOND OF JUNE*. THE GATE SENTENCE ITSELF IS THE SHARED FORM AND IS ENTITLED TO BE, AND IT STANDS.**
- **NO HANDOVER WAS STAGED IN THIS BATCH. NO CHAPTER PUT EZRA MBEKI OR TREVOR NUNN IN A ROOM. THE FIFTEENTH REMAINS THE LAST HANDOVER EVER STAGED. THE HOUR BETWEEN SIX AND SEVEN WAS NOT STAGED IN THIS BATCH AND IS NOT TO BE STAGED AGAIN IN THIS VOLUME. THE FINDINGS OF APRIL 2015 ARE FIVE MONTHS OLD AND WERE NOT RE-DERIVED, IMPROVED OR USED AS A DISCOVERY.**
- **NO STAND WAS ADDED TO THE COUNT ON THE WET PAVEMENT. IT IS CLOSED AT EIGHT, THE LAST BEING TWENTY PAST SIX ON SUNDAY 3 MAY 2015. HE WAS FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AWAY FROM A THING TWICE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS AND WALKED TOWARD NEITHER OF THEM, AND THAT IS NOT A STAND AND WAS NOT COUNTED AS ONE.**

## 3. THE PAVEMENT, THE CRATE, AND THE FIRST TIME SOMEBODY IN THIS BOROUGH FOUND OUT THAT A THING HAD AN ORIGIN NOBODY COULD NAME — CHAPTER 0175

**ON SATURDAY THE EIGHTEENTH OF JULY 2015 TWO TRESTLE TABLES AND A BOX OF WATER BOTTLES WERE ON A PAVEMENT ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE MARKET, PUT OUT AT ABOUT ELEVEN AND BROUGHT IN AT ABOUT FIVE SINCE ABOUT THE THIRD OF JULY, WITH NOTHING WRITTEN ON THEM, AND A CRATE WAS BESIDE THEM THAT NOBODY BROUGHT.**

- **THE CRATE ARRIVED ON THE FRIDAY OF THE TENTH OF JULY AND IS NOT ANYBODY'S.** It came out of the back of the shop because the man from the cold store picked an empty out of the box in front of people and had nowhere to put it but the crate that was already behind the shop for onions. **THE CRATE IS NOT A DECISION, IT IS A CONSEQUENCE, AND THE TWO ARE NOT THE SAME THING AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH CAN TELL YOU THE DIFFERENCE.**
- **BY THE EIGHTEENTH THE CRATE HAD A PLACE.** It stands against the leg of the near table and not beside the bin, and there were four empties standing up in it and two fulls at about half past eleven, and at about five the man from the cold store carried four empties and two fulls out to a sack and took the crate in with them. **THIS PARAGRAPH PREVIOUSLY SAID *FOUR EMPTIES ... AND SIX AT ABOUT FIVE*, WHICH NORMALISED A DRAFTING FAULT INSTEAD OF RECORDING IT: line 111 OF CHAPTER 0175 READ *FOUR EMPTIES AND TWO EMPTIES INTO A SACK*, WHICH CONTRADICTS LINE 27 OF THE SAME CHAPTER, WHERE THE CRATE HAS TWO FULL BOTTLES IN IT AND FOUR EMPTIES STANDING UP. THE SECOND IS *FULLS* AND IS NOW *FULLS*.** **THE TABLES AND THE BOX CANNOT BE POINTED AT. A CRATE CAN. A CRATE IS A CONTAINER, AND A CONTAINER IS A PLACE A THING CAN BE PUT, AND A PLACE A THING CAN BE PUT IS THE FIRST HALF OF AN ARRANGEMENT, AND THE MAN WHO FILLS IT IS A MAN.** Four people in this borough know the crate is there and three of them work at that shop.
- **A MAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-EIGHT WHO HAS SOLD FRUIT OFF THAT FRONTAGE ON SATURDAYS FOR NINE YEARS SAID, UNASKED, TO THE PAVEMENT AND NOT TO ANYBODY, THAT HE DOES NOT KNOW WHO PUT IT THERE AND THAT IT WAS THERE AT HALF PAST NINE WHEN HE CAME WITH HIS VAN, AND THAT NOBODY IS GOING TO BE ABLE TO TELL HIM EITHER, AND WHY: THE SECOND ONE OF US SAYS THE NAME OF THE THING OUT LOUD, IT IS A THING TWO PEOPLE KNOW ABOUT, AND BY THE FOLLOWING JUNE THERE IS A FORM WITH A NAME BOX ON IT AND THE FORM IS WORSE THAN THE TABLE.**
- **THE FINDING, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS FOUND OUT THAT A THING IN IT HAS AN ORIGIN NOBODY CAN NAME: THE ORIGIN IS NOT A DOCUMENT AND NOT A PERSON ANYBODY CAN BE ASKED ABOUT. HE ASKED NOBODY. THE MAN OF THIRTY-TWO STOOD AT THE END OF THAT FRONTAGE FOR ABOUT A QUARTER OF AN HOUR AND ASKED NOBODY ANYTHING.**
- **NOBODY COUNTS THE EMPTIES AND THE CHAPTER SAYS WHY: four empties in a crate is a number of bottles and is not the same number, and a number of people with nobody's name on it is a list of people, and this borough has already got two of those and has never once wanted a third.** He has not been thanked and nobody refused to be thanked and he is not going to be recognised. The shade on that pavement moves about four feet every two hours and everybody who puts a table in the shade knows it and nobody has written down how it works.

## 4. THE HINGE: A MONTH-OLD SHEET, A PROPOSAL, FOUR PEOPLE WHO WERE ALL RIGHT, AND A SENTENCE THAT IS GOING TO COST SOMEBODY — CHAPTER 0176

**ON SUNDAY THE NINETEENTH OF JULY 2015 THE SHEET OF THE NINETEENTH OF JUNE WAS A MONTH OLD, AND A WOMAN OF ABOUT FORTY-THREE STOOD UP IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP IN TIDEGLASS AND PROPOSED THAT IT BE PRINTED AGAIN AND PUT ROUND EVERY BUILDING IN THE BOROUGH ON A FRIDAY.**

- **FOUR PEOPLE IN THAT ROOM AND EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS RIGHT ABOUT SOMETHING.** The woman of about forty-three was right that a correct sheet is the cheapest thing anybody has done on those four streets in nine months and that a document with a date on it is the only repeatable act this borough owns. The man of about sixty-four, a duty clerk who is the person a printing run has to go through, was right that a sheet is not a document, that a document puts a name in a box, and that nobody is required to keep to three words printed under a heading. The woman of about fifty-six, who has the keys, was right that the June sheet reached nine buildings because it went round in a tray with nine other things in it, two of them a lunch menu and a leaflet about a closure, and that sending trays round on purpose takes that away and puts a schedule in its place, and a schedule is a person.
- **THE SECOND PRINT OF THAT SHELL OF THE SECOND COPY IS NOT A FINDING AND IS NOT STAGED AGAIN: THE JUNE SHEET WAS NOT WITHDRAWN, THE SECOND SHEET WITH ITS EMPTY COLUMN WAS NOT WITHDRAWN, NEITHER WAS ANNOTATED, AND NOBODY IN ANY OF THE NINE BUILDINGS KNOWS THERE ARE TWO OF THEM.** The man of sixty-four took two hundred June sheets out of a cupboard on the tenth of July and nobody in that building knows to this day that he did.
- **THE PROPOSAL WAS NOT MINUTED, NOT REFUSED AND NOT AGREED, AND NOBODY WAS PUT TO ANYBODY, AND A MAN STANDING UP IN A ROOM WITH AN IDEA IS NOT A REQUEST.** He may not chair anything and there is no chair of that body.
- **AND ONE SENTENCE WENT OUT OF THAT ROOM, AND IT WAS NOT SAID BY THE PERSON WHO MADE THE PROPOSAL.** The woman of fifty-six said at the door, to the man of sixty-four, that it is the cheapest thing anybody has done on those four streets this year, that it has got no name on it, and that is the whole of why it works, and the day somebody asks her why it works she will have to say who told her and she is not going to; and she told him that so that he could be the person she does not tell. **IN ABOUT A YEAR SOMEBODY IS GOING TO WANT TO KNOW WHERE THAT SENTENCE CAME FROM, AND THREE PEOPLE IN THAT ROOM COULD ANSWER IT, AND WHICH OF THEM WILL IS NOT GOING TO BE WRITTEN DOWN EITHER. THE READER IS NOT TOLD.**

## 5. A CORRECT REQUEST, GRANTED QUICKLY, WITH NO PAPER ON IT, AND THE BILL FOUR MILES AWAY — CHAPTER 0177

**ON TUESDAY THE TWENTY-FIRST OF JULY 2015 A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-ONE, WHO HAS HAD A PITCH AT A MARKET FOR ABOUT TWENTY-TWO YEARS AND IS ON SITE AT FIVE, ASKED A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FIVE IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A BUILDER'S MERCHANT FOR A DOOR AND A TAP, AND HE SAID YES IN ABOUT THREE SENTENCES AND LEFT A PADLOCK UNLATCHED.**

- **SHE HAD ASKED FOR A TAP TWICE THIS YEAR AND WAS POLITE BOTH TIMES AND STOPPED ASKING. SHE ASKED FOR A LOO. HE SAID: THERE IS A WELFARE HUT IN THE YARD ON THIS COMPOUND, IT HAS BEEN LOCKED SINCE JUNE, IT IS NOT OURS, IT IS STANDING HERE UNTIL THE NEXT JOB, THERE IS A UNIT ON THE WATER INSIDE IT AND A TAP ON THE WALL OUTSIDE IT, PUT YOUR PEOPLE ON THE CORNER BY THE GATE AND NOT BY THE OFFICE, BE OFF BY HALF SIX BECAUSE THE GATE IS SHUT BY A MAN WHO WILL NOT BE NICE ABOUT IT, AND I WILL LEAVE THE PADLOCK UNLATCHED, AND THAT IS NOT PERMISSION, THAT IS A MAN WHO HAS NOT LOCKED IT.** No paper, no reference, nothing written down, and nobody in that room asked him to.
- **THE UNIT CAME FROM A HIRE YARD OVER THE BOUNDARY. IT WAS BOOKED INTO THAT YARD ON FRIDAY THE SEVENTEENTH AT ABOUT TEN PAST FOUR BY A MAN WITH A JOB AND A COMPOUND AND A PADLOCK. BEFORE THAT IT WAS PENCILLED IN ON A BOARD FOR A MARKET HALL FOUR MILES AWAY, IN ANOTHER BOROUGH, AND THAT PENCILLED BOOKING WAS RELEASED ON THE FRIDAY AFTERNOON BY THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THAT BOARD, BECAUSE ONE FIRM BOOKING AND ONE PENCILLED ONE IS A VERY ORDINARY FRIDAY.**
- **THE COST FELL ON A WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-THREE WHO HAS THE KEYS TO THAT HALL AND CLEANS IT HERSELF. SHE HAS BEEN TELLING SIX TRADERS A DAY FOR SIX WEEKS THAT THERE IS A TOILET AT THE LEISURE CENTRE, AND SHE IS TELLING THEM THE TRUTH, AND SHE DOES NOT KNOW THAT THE UNIT THAT WOULD HAVE GONE INTO HER TRADERS' BLOCK WAS RELEASED ON A FRIDAY EVENING. NOBODY IS GOING TO TELL HER.**
- **AND THE REASON NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS GOING TO GO AND LOOK IS NOT DISCRETION AND NOT KINDNESS AND IT DID NOT OCCUR TO ANYBODY AS A DECISION. IT IS THAT SHE IS WRITTEN DOWN. She is on a contract with her name on it and an address for it, and the day anybody rings that contract to ask whether a unit was released on the Friday, she stops being a woman who cleans a hall and becomes a person who has been asked about, and she will have to remember, and she will have to remember it in front of somebody who has come a long way to find out. A PERSON WHO IS WRITTEN DOWN TO DO A THING IS A PERSON SOMEBODY CAN RING ABOUT IT.**
- **HE COULD HAVE FOUND OUT IN FOUR WAYS IN AN HOUR AND USED NONE, AND THE REASON IS ABOUT HIM AND NOT ABOUT THE MARKET: he is not on anything, he has no department, and there is no building he could walk into on the Tuesday and ask in a way that would go anywhere. The whole of his standing here is that he can say a true thing out loud to a person in a room, and a true thing said out loud in a room goes into the room, and that is all it does, and it has never once come back with an answer.**
- **NOBODY WAS HURT AND NOBODY DIED AND NOTHING WAS HELPED. A THING WAS MOVED FROM A PLACE NOBODY WAS LOOKING AT TO A PLACE NOBODY IS LOOKING AT, FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AND A GATE IS NOT IN THAT CHAPTER AND THE FIGURE FOUR HUNDRED YARDS WAS NOT USED FOR IT, AND THE CHAPTER SAYS PLAINLY THAT THIS IS THE CHEAPEST OUTCOME ANYWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH AND THAT IT IS ALSO THE REASON THERE IS NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH ANYBODY CAN POINT AT.** He is not Colin Wharton, whose name was not said to anybody in this batch, and no Weir resident is described in anything.

## 6. A THING CARRIED IN DAYLIGHT, AND A THANK-YOU FOR SOMETHING ELSE — CHAPTER 0178

**ON WEDNESDAY THE TWENTY-TWOUND OF JULY 2015 A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-NINE, WHO LIVES ON THE SECOND FLOOR OF A BLOCK OFF A PARADE OF SHOPS IN TIDEGLASS, TOOK TWO BAGS OFF A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-SEVEN ON THE BOTTOM OF THAT STAIRCELL AND CARRIED FOUR UP FOUR FLOORS AT HALF PAST THREE IN THE AFTERNOON.**

- **SHE CAME IN WITH FOUR FULL BAGS AND WAS GOING TO DO IT IN FOUR GOES. HE WENT DOWN PAST HER, CAME BACK UP WITH HIS HANDS OUT, TOOK TWO BAGS OFF HER WITHOUT ASKING, AND SAID *IT IS FOUR FLOORS AND A BAG EACH, I HAVE TO GO DOWN ANYWAY.* THERE IS NO ARRANGEMENT, NO ROTA, NO LIST AND NO PERSON HE CANNOT SAY NO TO, AND NOBODY ASKED HIM TO.**
- **A MAN WITH A PUSHCHIC WAITED ON THE HALF-LANDING, TWO PEOPLE AT THE BOTTOM STEPPED ASIDE, A WOMAN AT A WINDOW LOOKED DOWN AND LOOKED AWAY. NOBODY OFFERED AND NOBODY CAME UP BEHIND HIM WITH A THIRD BAG. HE PUT THE FOUR BAGS ON HER LANDING FLOOR AND SAID HE WAS GOING DOWN AND WOULD BE TWO MINUTES AHEAD OF HER, AND SHE SAID SHE WOULD COME IN A MINUTE, AND HE SAID DO NOT BOTHER.**
- **THIS IS THE SECOND TIME IN A MONTH THIS BOROUGH HAS SEEN THE SHAPE AND THE SHAPE IS THE SAME AND THE PERSON IS DIFFERENT AND THE STREET IS DIFFERENT AND THE WEEK IS DIFFERENT, AND WHETHER IT IS THE SAME THING IS NOT SAID. On the sixteenth a man of sixty-three carried four buckets up a flight of steps in front of about nine people and nobody had asked him to. The one word that differs is that a bag of shopping is the cheapest thing anybody in this borough has ever been asked to carry, and the reason it costs nothing is that it is worth nothing, and that is the entire mechanism.**
- **AND THEN THE WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-SEVEN SAID THANK YOU, AND IT WAS NOT FOR THE BAGS. She thanked him for telling her in June that the water would not be off on the Wednesday, on the Monday, in a corridor, when she could still have done something about it, and she said nobody has ever asked you for that and nobody is going to. HE SAID IT WAS ON A BOARD. SHE SAID IT WAS ON A BOARD IN A CORROR AND YOU READ IT AND YOU TOLD ME. THE THANKING WENT TO THE CORRIDOR AND THE CARRYING WAS STANDING RIGHT THERE AND NOBODY PUT THEM TOGETHER, INCLUDING THE MAN WHO WAS CARRYING.**
- **THE CARRYING GOES ON BEING A THING THAT HAPPENED AND THERE IS NOWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH TO PUT IT, AND IN ABOUT A YEAR SHE MAY TELL IT AS A STORY ABOUT A MAN WHO CARRIED HER SHOPPING, AND BY THEN THE TWO WILL HAVE BEEN IN THE SAME STORY SO LONG THAT THE PERSON TELLING IT WILL NOT KNOW WHICH ONE OF THEM WAS THE FAVOUR.**
- **AND THE COST FELL ON THE PERSON WHO WAS NOT BEING CARRIED ANYTHING, AND THAT PERSON WAS IN THE ROOM.** A man of thirty-two was on that half-landing going down with nothing in his hands and he carried nothing and he is the only person in that block who knows both halves of it. If anything is ever asked about that stairwell the person anybody would ask is him, and not because he is in charge of anything, and he has never in his life been the person anybody brings an answer back to.
- **HE HAD A WORD FOR IT IN JUNE AND IT IS NOT HIS.** It belongs to a person of nineteen who is owed nothing and is owed it and got it for nothing, and she had it on a footbridge in May about something entirely different, and he did not say it then and he is not going to say it here. **AND THERE WAS NO OTHER WORD. HE LOOKED FOR ONE ON THAT HALF-LANDING FOR ABOUT AS LONG AS IT TAKES TO GO DOWN A FLIGHT OF STAIRS AND THERE WAS NOT ONE, AND NOT HAVING ONE IS NOT BETTER AND IT IS NOT A PRINCIPLE AND IT DID NOT OCCUR TO HIM AS ANYTHING AT ALL. IT IS A TUESDAY, AND THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A WORD THAT STOPS A THING HAPPENING AND NO WORD AT ALL IS NOT A MORAL POSITION. IT IS ONLY THAT THE BAG GOT CARRIED EITHER WAY.**

## 7. A ROOM, A HEAT DAY, AND A MAN WHO IS RIGHT ABOUT ONE STREET — CHAPTER 0179

**ON THURSDAY THE TWENTY-THIRD OF JULY 2015, THE FIRST DAY IN ABOUT SIX WEEKS THAT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAD TO THINK ABOUT WEATHER, A MAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-NINE WHO HAS LIVED ON HARKER STREET FOR TWELVE YEARS WENT INTO A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP ON A PARADE OF SHOPS IN TIDEGLASS AND SAID ONE TRUE THING.**

- **WHAT HE SAID WAS FOURTEEN WORDS AND IT TOOK HIM TWELVE YEARS: THERE IS NOWHERE ON HARKER STREET TO SIT IN THE SHADE AFTER TWO O'CLOCK.** The pavement there has a wall with about two feet of shadow on it at four in July on one side and nothing at all on the other, and there are thirty-one doors, and he has counted them about four times this year because he keeps looking at them.
- **HE WAS ASKED WHO IT WAS FOR AND SAID HE DID NOT KNOW, AND THAT WAS THE HONEST ANSWER, and it is not for old people, it is for whoever is out in the street at four o'clock in July.** He has watched three men try to do it in a fortnight and one of them do it in a hat.
- **A MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-FOUR, WHO DROVE THAT STREET TWICE A DAY FOR TWENTY-TWO YEARS IN A BUS, SAID THE OTHER HALF AND IT IS WHY THE ROOM IS GOING TO BE A PROBLEM: IN TWENTY-TWO YEARS THE ONE THING HE COULD HAVE DONE ABOUT ANYTHING ON THAT STREET WAS STOP AND SAY SOMETHING, AND THERE IS NO LIST, NO FORM AND NOBODY HE COULD HAVE RUNG, AND THAT HAS BEEN THE MOST USEFUL THING ABOUT THAT STREET AND IT IS GOING TO BE THE MOST DANGEROUS THING ABOUT IT, AND THE TWO THINGS ARE THE SAME THING. IF SOMETHING EVER DID HAPPEN ON THAT STREET, THE PERSON THIS BOROUGH WOULD COME TO IS HIM.**
- **HE SAID IT ABOUT HIMSELF, ONCE, AND DID NOT ASK FOR IT NOT TO BE MINUTED, AND NOTHING IS GOING TO BE MINUTED ANYWAY: he has never asked anybody for anything in twelve years and he is not going to start, and if somebody built him a bench on that street he would be the person who asked for it and then the person who can be asked why there is a bench, and in about two years he would be a man in a magazine with a photograph of a street with a man in it, and after that nobody on that street could say anything about the shade without him being in it.**
- **AND EVERYBODY IN THAT ROOM AGREED WITH HIM, AND THE AGREEING IS THE COST, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING THAT HAPPENED IN THAT ROOM THIS AFTERNOON.** The woman of about fifty-eight, who has the keys, said it was right and said it was not on anything. The man of seventy-four said it was right and said he had driven past it two thousand times. **FROM THAT AFTERNOON HARKER STREET HAS A PERSON IN A BUILDING WHO IS RIGHT ABOUT IT, AND THAT IS NOT A SERVICE AND DOES NOT BECOME ONE AND IS NOT A DOCUMENT, AND THERE IS NO INSTRUMENT IN THIS CITY THAT CAN STOP A BUILDING REMEMBERING A PERSON AND THERE IS NOT ONE THAT CAN TELL HIM IT HAS NOT REMEMBERED HIM EITHER, AND HE IS THE ONE WHO CAME.**
- **HE WAS ASKED NOTHING FOR THE WHOLE TIME HE WAS IN THAT ROOM.** A man of thirty-two has asked no question of anybody since the twenty-fifth of February and did not ask one, and it is the one afternoon in this borough where he could have asked two good ones and got good answers and it would have cost a man of sixty-nine about ninety seconds of his life. Nobody asked him his name and nobody asked which number he lives at and nobody wrote Harker Street down on anything.
- **AND THE HEAT DID NOTHING AND IT IS NOT GOING TO.** The window had been open since about one. Twenty-nine degrees. In 1998 it had been thirty-four. Nobody connected that to anything and nobody in that room suggested a tap, or a bottle of water, or a rota, or a form, or a list, or a shade, and nobody went out of the room. He walked to the parade, got on the bus, went nine stops to a shop he has been going to for twelve years, and the man of seventy-four said good afternoon to him on the stairs.

## 8. A FRIDAY UNDER THE STAIRS, AND THE FIRST DESTRUCTION OF THIS BOROUGH'S PAPERWORK IN NINE MONTHS — CHAPTER 0180

**ON FRIDAY THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF JULY 2015 THE CUPBOARD UNDER THE STAIRS ON THE GROUND FLOOR OF THE OLD WARD WAS EMPTIED BY A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-SIX, AND THE TRAY THAT WENT INTO IT ON THE TWENTY-NINTH OF JUNE WENT OUT AGAIN IN A SACK, AND THE SACK WENT INTO A SKIP.**

- **THE CUPBOARD IS EMPTIED ON A FRIDAY BY WHOEVER COMES THROUGH WITH A SACK. THERE IS NO ROTA FOR IT. THE BUILDING'S FRIDAY ROTA COVERS A DIFFERENT FLOOR AND HAS DONE SINCE ANYBODY CAN REMEMBER.** The man who came through with the sack is the same man who counted that shelf on the twenty-third of June, painted that room on the twenty-ninth, and carried the tray down those stairs at about nine on the twenty-ninth. **HE HAS NOT BEEN ASKED ABOUT THE TRAY, WAS NOT ASKED THEN, IS NOT BEING ASKED NOW AND IS NOT GOING TO BE.**
- **WHAT WAS IN THE TRAY, WHICH IS THE WHOLE OF WHAT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH WILL EVER KNOW AND WHICH WAS SEEN BY THREE PEOPLE: three meeting notices for a group that has not met since March, one of them a second reminder with a different date on it; a parking notice for a yard, with a yard on it and a date in June on it and a line about vehicles, and NOBODY IN THAT BUILDING CAN PLACE THE YARD AND IT HAS NOT BEEN ASKED ABOUT; AND ABOUT FIFTY PAGES OF SOMETHING SENT ROUND IN ONE BUILDING IN APRIL TO A LIST SOMEBODY HELD, WHICH CAME BACK OFF THE FRIDAY ROUND ON THE NINETEENTH OF JUNE AND DID NOT GO OUT AGAIN.** Nobody looked at what the fifty pages were. Nobody in that building, nobody on the floor above, nobody in this city.
- **AND THE FIFTY PAGES ARE GONE, AND THE FIGURE OF ABOUT SIXTY PIECES OF POST HAS LEFT A BUILDING FOR THE LAST TIME, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A PIECE OF THIS BOROUGH'S PAPERWORK HAS ACTUALLY BEEN DESTROYED — NOT FILED, NOT MOVED, NOT PUT IN A CUPBOARD, NOT SCANNED. AND THE READER IS NOT TOLD WHETHER THAT IS A LOSS OR A CORRECTION, BOTH OF THOSE ARE AVAILABLE, THEY DO NOT EXCLUDE EACH OTHER, AND NO INSTRUMENT IN THIS CITY CAN TELL WHICH ONE IT IS, BECAUSE TELLING WOULD REQUIRE SOMEBODY TO HAVE DECIDED, AND NOBODY DECIDED.**
- **THE ONLY INSTRUMENT THAT COULD SAY WHAT WAS IN THAT TRAY IS THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY WHO DECIDED IT, AND SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE ASKED, AND NOT BECAUSE SHE IS DIFFICULT. IF SHE IS ASKED, THEN IT WAS A DECISION; AND IF IT WAS A DECISION IT WAS MADE BY A PERSON; AND THE NEXT TIME A TRAY COMES BACK OFF A FRIDAY SOMEBODY WILL SAY *LAST TIME WE MADE A DECISION ABOUT A TRAY*, AND THE SECOND TIME A THING IS A DECISION IT HAS A PRECEDENT, AND A PRECEDENT HAS A NAME ON IT, AND THE NAME ON IT WOULD BE HERS.** She came down at about half past eight, stood in the doorway for about a minute and a half, said nothing, and went back up.
- **AND THE TWO OF THEM ARE BOTH ENTIRELY RIGHT AND NEITHER WILL EVER KNOW THAT THE OTHER ONE IS. ## 4. THE PROPOSAL, AND THE FINDING THAT THE BOROUGH COULD NOT REFUSE IT — CHAPTER 0185

**COUNCILLOR IVEN SORE PUT IT ON A TABLE OUT LOUD AT ABOUT HALF PAST TWO IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM, WITH EIGHT PEOPLE IN IT, AND EVERY SENTENCE SHE SAID WAS CORRECT, AND SHE IS NOT A MENACE AND SHE IS NOT WRONG AND SHE WAS NOT IMPROVED ON.** She said the May emergency was handled by about four people and that four people is what the borough has and is the only thing that has ever worked here, and she said she is not going to tell anybody that four people is not enough, and she said she has spent nine months watching people be frightened of the day somebody writes down who the four are.

**THE ARGUMENT FOR BUILDING IT WAS THAT IT IS EASIER AND NOTHING ELSE, AND IT IS THE TRUEST THING ANYBODY SAID IN THAT ROOM IN FOUR MONTHS: A PERSON WHO IS NOT PAID AND NOT REQUIRED CANNOT BE SENT TO A STREET, CANNOT BE SENT TWICE, AND CANNOT BE SENT AT ALL IF THE PERSON IS ASLEEP. THE ARGUMENT AGAINST WAS ALSO TRUE AND WAS ONE SENTENCE: EVERYTHING THAT WAS CORRECT IN JUNE WAS CORRECT BECAUSE THERE WAS NO INSTRUMENT, AND IT WAS SAID OUT LOUD AGAINST A PAGE IN A TRAY WITH ONE READER AND AGAINST A TELEPHONE CALL IN JUNE THAT THE OFFICE DID NOT WRITE DOWN BECAUSE THERE IS NOWHERE TO WRITE IT DOWN.**

**AND THE FINDING, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING THAT HAPPENED: THE BOROUGH COULD NOT REFUSE IT. NOT WOULD NOT — COULD NOT. A BODY THAT CANNOT REQUIRE ANYBODY CANNOT BE TOLD WHAT IT WILL DO, AND A PROPOSAL MADE TO SUCH A BODY IN A ROOM IN DAYLIGHT CANNOT BE TAKEN BACK, BECAUSE TAKING IT BACK WOULD REQUIRE SOMEBODY TO BE ABLE TO SAY NO ON BEHALF OF A THING THAT HAS NEVER BEEN ABLE TO SAY ANYTHING ABOUT ANYBODY. NOBODY SAID NO. TWO PEOPLE SAID THEY WERE NOT SURE, AND THE NOT BEING SURE WAS NOT A NO AND COULD NOT BE TURNED INTO ONE, AND IT STAYED WHERE IT WAS.**

**AND THE SECOND HALF OF THE FINDING IS THAT ABOUT FOUR PEOPLE HAS BECOME A HABIT, AND A HABIT IS NOT A DECISION AND HAS NO DATE ON IT AND CANNOT BE GOT OUT OF.** Nothing was written down and nobody put a name to anything. The heat did not by itself make anything into a rota, and the chapter says so, and the thing that made the rota was a folder somebody carried up a flight of stairs on the thirteenth of August. **THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS ITEM ENDED *NOTHING WAS WRITTEN DOWN. **THE SEVEN CLAUSES, AS READ, AND THEY ARE CANON: 1. PRECEDENCE — where two services disagree about what happens first, this order decides which one goes first; it is decided by a person; a person is a person and not a committee. 2. THE FIELD — the order is administered in a field, and the field holds four things, a person's name, the hour the person was called, the hour the person went home, and the thing the person was called for, AND NOTHING ELSE GOES IN THE FIELD. 3. THE CALL — a person in this district may be called on to work; a person who has been called on may not decline; the call is made by a person; the call is not required to be in writing and there is no form for it. 4. CLOSURE — where a hazard is inside a district boundary the district may be closed; a closure is not required to be heard before it is made; a closure is posted on the street it closes. 5. TRANSFER — where a person is to be moved from one site to another, the sending site holds precedence over the receiving site until the receiving site has confirmed capacity IN WRITING. 6. THE SECOND CALL — a person whose name is in the field may be called again at any time, without limit, and no person may decline a second call. 7. RENEWAL — this order stands for ninety days from the date of making; at the end of that period it is renewed or it is not renewed; page two.**

## 6. THEY ARE TAKEN, AND THEY CAN BE FOUND NOW, AND IT IS CORRECT — CHAPTER 0187

**ON SATURDAY THE TWENTY-SECOND OF AUGUST, NINE DAYS AFTER THE ORDER WAS MADE, THE FIRST CALL WAS MADE AT ABOUT SEVEN IN THE MORNING BY A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-EIGHT WHO IS A CONTINUITY FIELD MANAGER FOR A COMPANY THAT SUPPLIES THIS CITY'S SERVICES, AND HE ASKED ABOUT NINE PEOPLE IN A DOORWAY ON A STREET NEAR THE MARKET, AND ABOUT NINE OF THEM SAID YES, AND EIGHT OF THEM WERE AT THE END OF THE STREET INSIDE TWENTY MINUTES. HE SENT NOBODY AND HE POSTED NOTHING.**

- **THE MACHINERY WORKS, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME ANY HUMAN BEING IN THIS BOROUGH HAS ARRANGED NINE PEOPLE AT SEVEN IN THE MORNING. A man of about twenty-three carried four boxes of water and then a chair up two flights and was thanked and said it was nothing.
