## 6. THE ORDER AS IT STANDS AT THE CLOSE OF THE VOLUME, AND IT MAY NOT BE ALTERED IN ONE WORD

**MADE THURSDAY THE THIRTEENTH OF AUGUST 2015, IN FORCE, TWO PAGES, AND THE SECOND OF THEM IS THE LAST OF THEM. READ ALOUD IN DAYLIGHT IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP ON A PARADE OF SHOPS IN TIDEGLASS TO FOUR PEOPLE.**

1. **PRECEDENCE** — where two services disagree about what happens first, this order decides which one goes first; it is decided by a person; a person is a person and not a committee.
2. **THE FIELD** — the order is administered in a field, and the field holds four things, a person's name, the hour the person was called, the hour the person went home, and the thing the person was called for, **AND NOTHING ELSE GOES IN THE FIELD.**
3. **THE CALL** — a person in this district may be called on to work; a person who has been called on may not decline; the call is made by a person; the call is not required to be in writing and there is no form for it.
4. **CLOSURE** — where a hazard is inside a district boundary the district may be closed; a closure is not required to be heard before it is made; a closure is posted on the street it closes.
5. **TRANSFER** — where a person is to be moved from one site to another, the sending site holds precedence over the receiving site until the receiving site has confirmed capacity **IN WRITING**.
6. **THE SECOND CALL** — a person whose name is in the field may be called again at any time, without limit, and no person may decline a second call.
7. **RENEWAL** — this order stands for ninety days from the date of making; at the end of that period it is renewed or it is not renewed; page two.

**PAGE TWO, AND IT IS THE WHOLE OF THE VOLUME'S ARGUMENT ARRIVING INSIDE A MECHANISM: *This order is renewed on the eleventh of November 2015, or it is not renewed.* AGREED BY — and the line goes down the page and stops about two inches from the bottom edge and there is nothing after it.**

- **THE NINETY DAYS IS A RENEWAL CLAUSE AND NOT AN EXPIRY. NOBODY RENEWED IT AND NOBODY EXPIRED IT AND NOBODY RENEWNED IT, AND THE DATE IS KNOWN, NAMED ON PAGE TWO, AND UNANSWERED, AND THE VOLUME ENDS WITH IT UNANSWERED, AND WHETHER ANYBODY RENEWS AND WHETHER ANYBODY RENAMES THE BLANK TERM ARE VOLUME 05'S BUSINESS.** No date, read time, start time or expiry may ever be put on any clause.
- **THE ORDER IS VALID AND IT WORKS AND IT WORKS BY PUTTING A PERSON IN A FIELD. IT IS THE ONLY INSTRUMENT ANYBODY IN THIS CITY HAS EVER WRITTEN DOWN THAT WOULD WORK. IT IS NOT SOFTENED BY ANYTHING IN THE CLOSE AND IT IS NOT TOUCHED BY THE CLOSE AT ALL.**

## 1. THE PERMISSION FROM ALDERWICK, AND WHAT IT IS, AND WHAT IT COST

**A MUTUAL-AID PERMISSION CAME DOWN FROM A CITY ON THE OTHER BANK ON WEDNESDAY 30 SEPTEMBER 2015, AND IT IS TWO PAGES, CORRECT IN EVERY SENTENCE, SIGNED AT BOTH ENDS, AND IT IS ABOUT A PERSON BY NAME, AND IT IS THE FIRST DOCUMENT ABOUT A PERSON BY NAME IN NINE MONTHS.** Its clauses: a person named in the schedule may be asked to work in the other city for not exceeding fourteen days; a person asked takes the work or does not take it, at the hour the work begins; a person named is paid the going rate, at the printed rate, in money, in full, before the work begins; a person named keeps a right of return on the day the work ends without asking anybody for anything; where a person is receiving care in one city the other city pays that care and the person does not move; a claim arising out of work done under the permission is made in the city where the work was done and not in the city the person came from; and nothing in the permission requires a person to be asked, to be found, to be named, or to be told anything. Reference AM/15/221. The schedule carries **nine** names. **THERE IS NO LINE UNDER EITHER SIGNATURE WITH NOTHING IN IT, AND THAT IS THE FIRST THING JONAS MERCER LOOKED AT, AND THE ONLY THING ABOUT THE PAGE THAT MADE HIM STOP FOR MORE THAN A SECOND. SOMEBODY IN THIS CITY SIGNED IT ON MONDAY AT A COUNTER IN A BUILDING BY THE WATER, AND NOBODY IN THE ROOM COULD HAVE SAID WHICH OF THE PEOPLE ON THAT COUNTER, AND THE WATER OFFICE DOES NOT HAVE A LIST EITHER.** Signed for Alderwick by a woman of about fifty-two, Irene Sandiford, a duty clerk, who is correct in every sentence she says, is not the person who agreed to it, said so twice, and is not available to be asked about it. She came on the morning train on the thirtieth and again on the third of November and went back on the twelve-fifteen and the six.

**THE FINDING OF THE BATCH IS ABOUT WHAT IT DID TO PEOPLE AND IT IS NOT A SCANDAL AND IT IS NOT A RESCUE. Three things happened and all three are correct and none of them helps anybody.**

- **A PERSON THIS BOROUGH COULD NOT FIND WAS FOUND, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH ASKED FOR THAT.** **EWEN ASHGROVE, ABOUT SIXTY-TWO**, walked out of one room on the second floor of a house in Kilburn Street in the second week of April with a bag. The room was let again in June. Fourteen days' rent, about ninety pounds, has been in a tin in a drawer since April, and the person who let the room has been to three places in this city about it and has been told the correct thing at all three. The eighth row of the schedule says he is at Alderwick in a rented room in a work contract of fourteen days at a time, renewed six times, present since 11 August 2015. **A duty clerk was sent a schedule to fill in, one of the names on it went to a person who had been carrying it, and the person sent it on, because a schedule with a name on it is a schedule with a name on it and nobody had a reason to take one out.** He is not missing and nobody was in danger and nobody was sent for and nobody was brought back.
- **THE THING THAT LEFT.** **A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-SEVEN**, who has his own tipper and a flatbed and does work for whoever pays him and is on no rota and on nothing, went across the water on **Tuesday 6 October** for fourteen days, was told at about ten past six in the morning at a yard entrance by a man of about sixty-seven from the water side who had met him once in June, and who read a line off a folded piece of A4 that he then put in his pocket. He had said yes on Saturday the third. Nobody told him in between. The money is in an envelope in the cab before the work and it is the going rate for the work over there and it is more than the going rate here. He went, he is all right, he is paid, and he is gone. **THE BOROUGH HAS NEVER HAD A MECHANISM FOR A PERSON COMING BACK AND THERE IS NOT GOING TO BE ONE**, because a right of return needs nothing and a mechanism for a return needs somebody to be in it. **THE CHAPTER HE WAS TOLD AT SAYS HE WOULD BE BACK ON THE TWENTIETH, AND THAT IS THE DATE CARRIED FORWARD, AND AN EARLIER LINE IN THIS BLOCK THAT SAID HE CAME BACK ON MONDAY 19 OCTOBER IS WRONG: 19 OCTOBER 2015 WAS A MONDAY BUT IT IS NOT A DATE ANY CHAPTER GIVES AND IT IS NOT THE END OF FOURTEEN DAYS FROM THE SIXTH.** He is out again on Thursdays and drove his own tipper past the end of Peverell Street at about half past six on the evening of Tuesday 10 November. He is on nothing, is owed nothing, is not a thread, and has not been asked one question by anybody in either city.
- **THE THING THAT WAS FOUND TURNED OUT NOT TO HAVE ASKED TO BE FOUND.** **ON TUESDAY 3 NOVEMBER ASHGROVE CAME ACROSS THE ESTUARY ON THE MONDAY MORNING BOAT ON HIS OWN ACCOUNT, HAVING BEEN TOLD ON FRIDAY 30 OCTOBER THAT HIS DETAILS HAD BEEN PASSED TO A CITY HE HAD LEFT, TO FIND OUT WHY, AND HE SAID THE SENTENCE HIMSELF: NOBODY ASKED ME TO BE FOUND. HE SAID IT TWICE AND BOTH TIMES IT WAS TRUE, AND NOBODY OBJECTED TO ANY PART OF IT.** He said what it cost him, which is nothing: that nobody had come and found him, that nobody had sent anybody, that he had a room and a contract and the money comes in an envelope before the work, and that he would not go back to the room in Kilburn Street on a Tuesday. **HE DESCRIBED THE MOMENT AS HE WAS AT ALDERWICK ON WEDNESDAY 30 SEPTEMBER, ON A CONTRACT HE HAD BEEN ON SINCE AUGUST, WITH A CLERK IN THAT CITY WRITING HIS NAME IN A LINE ON A PIECE OF A4, AND A FIRST DRAFT HAD PUT HIM ON A GULLY IN A THIRD CITY HE HAD NEVER LIVED IN WITH A WOMAN ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE WATER WRITING HIS NAME, WHICH IS A THIRD PARTY TO A TWO-PARTY PERMISSION AND IS NOT TRUE AND WAS CUT.** He said the second half of it, which is the part nobody in the room wanted: **he is now carrying a doctor in a town he cannot name, on the other side of the water, paid for out of a council that has never heard of him, under a clause that is correct, and he cannot say no to it, and he would like to, and the only way anybody can get out of this arrangement is to write, and he has not written anything to anybody since he was twenty-two and is not going to start in order to be tidy.** He is going back on the half-past-five boat on the day.
- **AND THE SEVEN ROWS ARE RECONCILED WITH THE NINE NAMES, BECAUSE NOBODY HAD DONE IT.** The sheet Sandiford brought back on 3 November is a different sheet from the one she read out on 30 September: it is the sheet that gets filled in when the fourteen days run out, it carries **seven** rows, six of them already dated, and the seventh is his, in her own hand, because she had written it on a train. **A RETURN SHEET IS NOT THE SCHEDULE AND IS NOT SUPPOSED TO CARRY NINE ROWS. SIX OF THE NINE TOOK WORK AND SIX CAME BACK WITH DATES ON IT, AND THE SEVENTH IS THE ONE WHO CAME ACROSS THE ESTUARY ON HIS OWN ACCOUNT, AND THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ARE NOT ON THAT SHEET AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS ASKED WHY.** His row reads **contract renewed six times**, which is what the schedule of 30 September also said and which is arithmetically exact: fourteen days from 11 August 2015 comes round for the sixth time on **3 November 2015**, the day he was in the room.

**AND THE COST FELL WHERE THE COST FALLS IN THIS ACCOUNT, WHICH IS ON A PERSON WHO CANNOT BE FOUND AND CANNOT BE ASKED. A woman of about thirty-eight in that room said the true thing — a permission finds people the same way the August document finds them, and the only difference is the handwriting and the fact that one of them was signed twice — and stopped, because a person in a room saying that is heard as an objection, and she was not objecting, and about four people in that room thought the same sentence at the same moment and about four of them had worked out before now that this city has no instrument for saying a true thing without it also sounding like a complaint.**

## 2. THE RAIN OF MONDAY 12 OCTOBER, AND WHAT IT COST, AND THE THING NOBODY CAN FIND OUT

**THE RAIN CAME IN FROM THE WEST DURING THE NIGHT OF SUNDAY 11 OCTOBER, STOPPED BEING HEAVY AT ABOUT HALF PAST SEVEN ON THE MONDAY AND STOPPED ALTOGETHER AT ABOUT ELEVEN, AND NOBODY DIED, NOBODY WAS IN A HOSPITAL BECAUSE OF THE WATER, NOBODY WAS SENT FOR, AND NOBODY WAS FETCHED.** The run at the bottom of Peverell Street was at six inches on Thursday the twenty-fourth of September and was at two feet and rising at ten to five. About five people were on that ground and they are the same four or five as they were in May, in June and in August, and they are not chosen, they are not on anything, they cannot be sent for, and there is nothing anywhere in this city that could put a sixth person into a yard at ten to five in the morning, and a body that cannot require anybody cannot be told what it will do. **THE SPILL OF 16 MAY WAS NOT RE-DERIVED, IMPROVED ON OR USED AS A DISCOVERY AND IS NOT MENTIONED IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS.**

**AND AT ABOUT TEN TO FIVE SOMEBODY WENT ALONG THE OLD BRICK BASE OF A CLOSE-BOARDED FENCE AND PULLED THREE BOARDS OFF THE BOTTOM, AND THE WATER WENT THROUGH, AND THE WALL STOOD.** Jonas Mercer was about ten feet away with a spade facing the other way, heard it, turned round, and saw a light behind a man and a set of boots and then there was nothing. He did not see a face and **HE DID NOT ASK, AND THERE IS NOBODY IN THIS CITY HE COULD HAVE SAID IT TO EVEN IF HE HAD.** Two doorways in that yard stayed dry. A yard next door took about a foot on the floor of a workshop and a man of about seventy-seven lost a shelf of stock and said that anybody with a bucket could have done it, which was true, and then said that there is no way on God's earth of finding out who, which was also true. **THE THREE BOARDS WENT DOWN THE YARD AND UNDER THE RUN AND WERE NOT SEEN AGAIN. THE TWO PEOPLE WHO MIGHT HAVE BEEN ASKED WERE ABOUT FORTY FEET AWAY WITH THEIR BACKS TO IT AND NEITHER TURNED ROUND, AND NEITHER HAS SAID A WORD ABOUT IT SINCE AND NEITHER IS GOING TO BE ASKED.** The water went down an inch an hour from about ten and was gone properly by about two in the afternoon. The man of about seventy-seven finished on about six of his own bags and Jonas Mercer carried four of them up the street without saying why and he said nothing and took them.

## 3. THE FINDING ABOUT A PERMISSION AND AN OBLIGATION, AND IT IS NOT ANSWERED

**ON SUNDAY 18 OCTOBER, IN A ROOM OVER A SHOP, IN DAYLIGHT, IN FRONT OF ABOUT NINE PEOPLE, TOMAS RENN SAID THE SENTENCE NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS SAID OUT LOUD IN A ROOM: A PERMISSION AND AN OBLIGATION ARE OPPOSITES, AND THIS BOROUGH HAS BEEN LIVING ON THE SECOND ONE FOR NINE MONTHS AND WAS HANDED THE FIRST ONE EIGHTEEN DAYS EARLIER IN PRINT. **THE INTERVAL IS EIGHTEEN DAYS BECAUSE THE PERMISSION CAME DOWN ON WEDNESDAY 30 SEPTEMBER AND THIS MEETING IS SUNDAY 18 OCTOBER, AND IT IS NOT SIX DAYS; AN EARLIER LINE IN THIS BLOCK AND FOUR STATE FILES SAID SIX DAYS, WHICH IS NOT ANY INTERVAL IN THIS ACCOUNT, AND IT WAS CORRECTED IN THE PROSE OF 0199 AND HERE RATHER THAN PROPAGATED.** His full sentence: one of them is a door and the other one is a hand on it, and this borough has been standing on the hand for nine months and it has worked, and the reason it has worked is that the only thing anybody has ever been able to put on anybody in this city is a hand, and the hand does not need a reason, and nobody has ever been able to write the reason down.

**HE IS RIGHT AND HE IS NOT SOFTENED AND JONAS MERCER IS RIGHT TOO AND HE COULD NOT IMPROVE IT AND DID NOT TRY.** Renn put three things that have been minuted since the beginning of the year and are still correct: a bond, which is not money but something a person has to hand over before taking a decision that affects other people and gets back if the decision was right; tools that belong to nobody, one set at the shop on a Friday for anybody with a job and no van; and **the person who does the work saying whether the work is safe — which is clause one, clause three and the field in clause two with four things in it of the document made on 13 August, and which Renn asked for in a room like that one in March, **THAT THE ORDER'S CLAUSE TWO IS THE FIELD, WHICH 0199 NOW NAMES AS CLAUSE TWO BECAUSE THE ONLY CORRECT WAY TO NAME IT IS BY ITS NUMBER**, and which HE IS NOT WITHDRAWING AND IS GOING TO KEEP ASKING FOR IN THAT ROOM EVERY THREE MONTHS.** Jonas Mercer said *you are right* and *there is nothing I can put next to it*, and then gave Renn the one true thing he had: **he has asked for three things and not one of them has ever been said no to, and that is the reason he has not got any of them, and it is not the reason anybody in this city would give if they were asked.** Renn said it was the first useful thing anybody had said to him in six months and that he was not going to repeat it.

**AND RENN'S OWN QUESTION IS UNANSWERED AND IS STILL THE ENGINE, AND HE TOLD JONAS MERCER ABOUT IT IN THAT ROOM, IN FRONT OF NINE PEOPLE, IN THE AFTERNOON:** in the spring he is going to put it to somebody who can answer it, and it is not going to be Jonas Mercer, and Jonas Mercer is not going to be in the room, and he is telling him then so that he cannot stand in a corridor in six months and say nobody thought he should have been there. Jonas Mercer said *that's right*. **ABOUT NINE PEOPLE CAME TO THAT MEETING AND JONAS MERCER WAS IN THE ROOM AS WELL, AND 0199 NOW CLOSES WITH THE NINE OF THEM GOING OUT INTO A STREET; AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THAT LAST LINE SAID EIGHT AND WAS WRONG. THE TWO INTERNAL DATES IN THAT ROOM WERE ALSO REPAIRED AT THE SAME TIME: RENN'S *LAST TUESDAY* POINTED AT 13 OCTOBER AND HE MEANT 6 OCTOBER, AND *CAME ON WEDNESDAY* WAS AMBIGUOUS BETWEEN 30 SEPTEMBER AND 14 OCTOBER, AND BOTH NOW CARRY THE MONTH.** **YOLANDA FOFANA IS NOT NAMED, IS NOT IN A ROOM, IS NOT TOLD ANYTHING AND IS NOT ASKED ANYTHING, AND THE PHRASE *THE NINTH* IS NOWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS.**

**THE BATCH'S QUESTION IS RESTATED AS A FACT THAT IT IS STILL OPEN AND IT IS NOT ANSWED: A PERMISSION IS A THING A PERSON MAY DO. AN OBLIGATION IS A THING A PERSON HAS TO DO. NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS WORKED OUT WHAT EITHER OF THE MEN ON THE PERMISSION WAS HANDED. IT IS OPEN.**

## 4. THE THINGS THAT GOT WRITTEN DOWN AND THE THING THAT DID NOT

- **THE DRAWING IS ON MORE WALLS THAN IT WAS IN SEPTEMBER AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH CAN SAY HOW MANY, AND NO CHAPTER IN THIS BATCH STATES A NUMBER OF WALLS THAT WAS NOT ARRIVED AT.** Forty is the one figure and it came out of the Volume 04 close: out on the Friday morning into four places, forty walls by that night, more since. A place that has been discussed is a place that has been dismissed, and Peverell Street is busier than it was and nobody can say why.
- **ON FRIDAY 30 OCTOBER SOMEBODY WROTE ONE LINE, BADLY, ON THE BACK OF SOMETHING, WITH NO NAME ON IT, AND PUT IT IN A DRAWER.** A woman of about sixty-four called Beryl, who has worked behind a canteen hatch for six years and is on nothing, has opened that hatch on Friday afternoons for about six years for a man of about thirty-one who comes at ten to three, on her own time, with no one to ask. The correct thing is the thing he has watched happen in that room and has never told her about and she has never asked him about. **A DRAFT OF 0201 GAVE IT A NUMBER — *THE ELEVENTH TIME* HE HAD WATCHED SOMEBODY DO THIS, AND HE HAD BEEN COUNTING SINCE THE SPRING — AND BOTH HALVES OF THAT WERE CUT IN THE PROSE. *THE ELEVENTH TIME* IS A CLOSED FIGURE IN THIS ACCOUNT AND WAS USED IN THIS BLOCK AND IN `state/batch-summaries.md` AS A REASON FOR EXCUSING IT, AND A RUNNING COUNT IN JONAS MERCER'S HEAD IS THE ONE INSTRUMENT THIS BOROUGH HAS SPENT NINE MONTHS REFUSING TO BUILD, AND IT PUTS A MAN WHO HAS ASKED NOBODY A QUESTION SINCE 25 FEBRUARY IN CHARGE OF A TALLY. 0195 SAYS HE COUNTED NINE PEOPLE WITHOUT MEANING TO AND THAT NINE IS NOT A NUMBER THAT MEANS ANYTHING IN THIS BOROUGH, AND A CHAPTER MAY NOT GIVE HIM THE HABIT FOUR CHAPTERS LATER.** At about ten to four she took the back of a bread delivery docket off the pad and wrote *Fri. hatch open. till 6.* — five words, no date, no year, no hatch number, the last stroke through the printer's word underneath, and the truth is that she shut it at about half past four. **She folded it once, put it in a drawer under a canteen counter that has no lock on it and never has had one, and shut the drawer. HE SAW HER DO IT AND SHE KNEW HE SAW HER DO IT AND NEITHER OF THEM SAID A WORD AND HE IS NOT GOING TO ASK HER ABOUT IT AND HE IS NOT GOING TO TELL ANYBODY.** **THAT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A CORRECT THING IN THIS BOROUGH HAS COME WITH A PIECE OF PAPER ON IT AND THE PERSON WHO PAID FOR THE PAPER WAS THE PERSON WHO DID THE THING, and no list of people who cannot be found has been built in this borough in nine months and one has not been started.** The 25 June precedent of *agreed* and a date on the back of a note is unchanged and is not touched by this.
- **ON SUNDAY 18 OCTOBER A LIST OF THREE THINGS WAS WRITTEN IN ONE WOMAN'S HAND ON A PAD SHE TOOK HOME IN A HANDBAG**, and it is the only piece of paper that came out of that room that afternoon, and it is not in a field, and nobody in this city could produce it if they were asked. Mrs Obi, about thirty-six, was not asked.
- **A DRAWING OF THE SHAPE OF THE CITY IS NOW INSIDE A HALL OFF A PARADE OF SHOPS, gummed to a wall by a woman of about forty-two who has the key to that hall and has had it for about nine years, and it is there because the ones on shutters are outside and this one is inside where the people are.**

## 5. THE EMPTY SQUARE, AND THE FIRST TIME HE SAID ANYTHING ABOUT IT

**ON SATURDAY 7 NOVEMBER AT ABOUT HALF PAST TEN IN THE MORNING, IN DAYLIGHT, IN FRONT OF ABOUT NINE PEOPLE, A WOMAN WHO HAS THE KEY TO A HALL ASKED JONAS MERCER WHICH SQUARE ON THE DRAWING IS THE EMPTY ONE AND WHAT IS SUPPOSED TO GO IN IT, BECAUSE SHE HAD BEEN ASKED FOUR TIMES THAT WEEK AND SHE IS THE ONE WHO HAS TO STAND IN THAT ROOM AND SHE IS NOT PUTTING HER NAME TO AN ANSWER SHE HAS NOT GOT.**

**HE SAID HE DOES NOT KNOW, AND THEN HE SAID THAT HE READ THAT SHEET ON THE EIGHTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER BEFORE IT WENT ON ANY WALL, THAT IT HAS BEEN EMPTY ON EVERY COPY SINCE, THAT HE HAS NOT SAID THAT TO ANYBODY UNTIL THAT MORNING, AND THAT HE IS NOT GOING TO GUESS.** **THAT IS THE FIRST TIME IN SEVEN WEEKS HE HAS SAID ANYTHING ABOUT THE SQUARE TO ANYBODY, AND HE READ IT ON 18 SEPTEMBER WHILE A COMMITTEE CLERK WAS STILL TALKING AND HAS NOT SAID SO BEFORE.** He then gave the room the two correct and useless halves: it is not a district, because it has no term in it, and it is not a seat either, because a seat on that sheet is a shape with a name over it and there is no name over this one; and the line that comes into it from the district above goes nowhere, and goes nowhere because there is nothing on the other end of it yet. *So somebody left a room.* *Somebody left a room, or somebody is going to walk into it, and I know which of those two I would rather it was, and I have not got a reason, and I am not going to give you a reason I made up at half past ten on a Saturday in a hall with the heating on.*

**NOTHING WAS RESOLVED AND THE SQUARE IS NOT FILLED AND HE WAS GIVEN NOTHING.** No department, no form, no grade, no chair, no seat, no membership, no rota row, and nobody stood up and gave him anything, because it was half past ten on a Saturday in a hall and the nine people in it had come about a class and about a warm room. **THE WORD *WARDEN* IS NOWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS. THE SENTENCE IS IN THE ROOM NOW AND CANNOT BE GOT BACK OUT OF IT, AND THERE IS NO WAY OF KNOWING ON ANY EVENING IN DECEMBER WHICH ROOM IT IS IN OR WHO IS IN IT. A ROOM CAN HOLD A SENTENCE AND A ROOM CANNOT HOLD A PERSON, AND THAT IS NOT A NEW LINE OF THIS ACCOUNT AND NOT A MAXIMUM: IT IS SENTENCE OF CHAPTER 0144, WHERE HE SAID IT AND THEN STOPED HALFWAY THROUGH A SENTENCE CONTAINING IT, AND IN 0203 IT NOW SITS INSIDE THE PARAGRAPH THAT CARRIES THE CONSEQUENCE INSTEAD OF STANDING ALONE ABOVE IT AS A COMMENT ON THE SCENE.**

## 6. NELL ARDENT, AND FOUR BOXES, AND BEING RIGHT

**ON SATURDAY 24 OCTOBER A MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-SIX, WHO LET ASHGROVE A ROOM IN KILBURN STREET IN 2011 AND HAS HAD ABOUT NINETY POUNDS OF HIS IN A TIN SINCE APRIL, CAME TO THE OPEN COVENANTS LEGAL CLINIC WITH A QUESTION THAT HAD A PERSON'S NAME IN IT.** She is the only person in the room who was right, and her answer is that nobody can act on any part of it, including her. **The permission does not touch a tenancy: no document in either city mentions a landlord, a room, a deposit, an arrears or a sum of money, and the clause about claims is about claims arising out of work, and his money is not that. He can hand the money over and nobody can stop him and nobody will know. And if he does, two things happen: a man with money sent to him is a man with a bank, and a bank is a thing that can be looked at, and he is currently only findable because a duty clerk put a line next to his name in a list; and he will have done a thing, and there is no place in this city to write down that a landlord in Kilburn Street offered a man ninety pounds in October and was refused, or accepted, or ignored, or never got an answer. He will have done it and it will not exist.** He said *so what do I do*. *Nothing today. That is the answer.* **THERE ARE FOUR CARDBOARD BOXES ON THE TABLE UNDER THE WINDOW WITH THE WORD PARTY WRITTEN ON THEM IN MARKER PEN AND THEY HAVE BEEN EMPTY SINCE THE CLINIC OPENED, AND NOBODY ASKED HER ABOUT THE DRAWER AND THE DRAWER IS NOWHERE IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS. BEING RIGHT IS NOT A FINDING AND IT IS NOT A VICTORY AND IT IS NOT A LOSS, AND HER ARC PAYS FOR NOTHING.** Jonas Mercer was in the corridor and not in the room, and she came out and said: *the day I start telling a man what he is in a corridor is the day this room turns into something else, and it would not be a good something.*

**AND THE PERMITTED SAINT ORRA GATE SENTENCE WAS USED ONCE IN THIS BATCH, IN 0205, IN THAT FORM, UNSTAGED, BY JONAS MERCER TO NINA CALDER, AS THE ONE THING HE KNOWS IN THIS CITY THAT GOES ON BY ITSELF, AND NO TERM AFTER THE TWENTY-THIRD WAS NAMED, DATED OR ALLUDED TO IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS.** The Saint Orra west gate still runs on its local term, a term is six days and is never called a week, the rota has not been rebuilt and cannot be, the 11:00–13:30 row is still empty and still does not say *vacant*, Bram Osei's Thursday is still refused in his own handwriting with the second line in somebody else's hand and he has asked twice that it not be looked at, **AND NOBODY LOOKED AT IT IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS.** Ezra Mbeki and Trevor Nunn are not in a room, no handover was staged, the hour between six and seven on the morning of 29 November was not staged and 0208 says in one plain line that nobody read anything out and there was no list and no roll and nobody said anybody's name in order.

## 2. WHAT A LAPSED INSTRUMENT LEAVES, AND THE ONLY WAY THIS BOROUGH FINDS ANYTHING OUT

**ON TUESDAY 17 NOVEMBER 2015 JONAS MERCER WALKED THE BOROUGH FOR FIFTY MINUTES AND IT WAS ALL EXACTLY AS IT HAD BEEN.** Nothing taken down, nothing new put up, no gap anywhere he could put a finger into, the drawing still on the shutter at the top, the shutter at the bottom and the inside wall of the hall, the square in the middle of every one of them still with nothing in it, the river down, and about a quarter of an inch of silt on the pavement at the low end of Peverell Street with the gully outside the third door packed with it, because **a gully at the bottom of a street that floods silts up in a month and nobody in this borough came back with a bar.**

**AND THE MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-THREE IS NOT CALLED AGAIN, AND HE LOOKS DIFFERENT, AND NOBODY ASKS HIM.** He is the same man and not a second: he came at seven in the morning on 22 August to hold a gate open on his own arm and held it nine hours, was paid the going rate in money, has been called nine times since and has declined none, and held a gate in the dark for about an hour on 12 October. **WHAT JONAS MERCER NOTICED, AND COULD NOT PUT IN A SENTENCE FOR A WEEK, WAS THAT HE HAD HIS COAT OVER HIS ARM AND NOTHING IN HIS HANDS.** He said good morning and nothing else. He is not a man who has been set free and nobody is going to say that he has. He is on nothing, is owed nothing, and is not going to be asked.

**AND THE COUNTER, WHICH IS THE ONLY OBJECT IN THIS ACCOUNT THAT HAS EVER ANSWERED ANYTHING, WAS IN A SCENE FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE BATCH BEFORE THIS ONE, AND IT ANSWERED NOTHING, GAVE NO COUNT TO ANYBODY, WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT THE ORDER, AND WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT A LAPSE.** A woman of about sixty-five has been behind it for about nine years and has never been told anything. A man of about twenty-eight, who was in the room over a shop on 30 September and said one sentence about a schedule and a rate, and who was at that counter once in June, came in and said: *I want to know if there's anywhere a person can put the low end of that street.* **THE ANSWER HE GOT, TWICE AND IN THE SAME WORDS, WAS *THERE'S NO FORM FOR THAT*, AND HE SAID *I KNOW*, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE OF THE MEETING, WHICH TOOK ABOUT FOUR MINUTES AND WAS THE ONLY THING THAT HAPPENED ANYWHERE IN TIDEGLASS THAT DAY THAT WAS ABOUT THE LOW END OF PEVERELL STREET.** He had been trying since June to get the bottom of Peverell Street onto any piece of paper that exists in a drawer in this city; there is a drawing on the walls and no bottom of Peverell Street on it, and he knew that, and he came anyway, and he said he wanted to have asked it in a room with somebody in it. **THE ONLY THING HE SAID ABOUT THE OTHER HALF — that since the middle of September there has been no reason on any street in this city for anybody to be asked anything at all, and that he had noticed it the way a man notices a bus that has stopped coming — HE SAID ONCE, TO THE FLOOR, AND HE DID NOT TELL ANYBODY, INCLUDING JONAS MERCER, WHO STOOD AT THE OTHER END OF THE VESTIBULE THE WHOLE TIME AND SAID ONE WORD, WHICH WAS NONE.**

**THE EXACT MOTIF STRING *THERE IS NO FORM IN THIS BOROUGH* IS AT ZERO IN ALL TEN CHAPTERS, MEASURED. THE SHORTER CONSTRUCTION *THERE'S NO FORM FOR THAT* APPEARS TWICE AND BOTH ARE THE SAME LINE SPOKEN BY THE WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-FIVE, WHICH IS WHAT CARD 0206 ASKS FOR, AND THE SENTENCE IS ABOUT A STREET AND NOT ABOUT THE ORDER, AND THE ORDER AND THE IDEA OF A BOROUGH FORM ARE NOT PUT IN ONE SENTENCE ANYWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS. THE DRAWER UNDER THAT COUNTER WAS NOT OPENED, NOT COUNTED, NOT ASKED ABOUT AND IS NOWHERE IN CHAPTERS 205–214, AND THE SENTENCE A WOMAN PUT IN IT ON THE MORNING OF 20 MAY 2015 IS STILL IN IT.**

## 3. THE LETTER, THE BOUNDARY, THE CROSSING, AND HOW ANYBODY KNEW

**ON FRIDAY 20 NOVEMBER 2015 A ONE-PAGE LETTER ARRIVED, POLITE, SIGNED BY ISELIN KROGH, ABOUT FIFTY-ONE, CLERK OF A STANDING GROUP OF THREE AUTHORITIES THAT RUNS THE WATER FOR THREE TOWNS IN RAVENSMERE. ITS SECOND PARAGRAPH THANKED THIS CITY FOR THE ARRANGEMENT OF THE THIRTIETH OF SEPTEMBER AND ITS THIRD INVITED HIM TO SIT IN A ROOM ON THE FOURTH OF DECEMBER. ITS FOURTH PARAGRAPH READS: *WE RECORD YOU AS OUR CORRESPONDENT ON THE ABOVE.* THE WORD IS NOT TRUE AND HE SAID SO BACK ON THE SATURDAY, ON A SHEET OF HIS OWN, IN THE POST, AND HE CAME.**

**THERE IS NO BUDGET FOR IT, THERE IS NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH HE CAN BOOK A SEAT ON AND NO WAY OF BOOKING ONE ANYWHERE ELSE, AND THERE IS NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH THAT CAN MAKE HIM BE IN A ROOM IN ANOTHER CITY, AND THE WHOLE OF WHAT THE GROUP HAS IS A MAN WHO HAS GONE.** He said, out loud, before anybody had asked him anything, to three people on Sunday 22 November: **HE IS GOING AS A PERSON WHO IS THERE, AND HE IS NOT ANYBODY'S DELEGATE, AND THE ARRANGEMENT HAS NO WORD FOR THAT.** He said it first to Nell Ardent on the clinic stairs, then to Sanaa Iqbal in a hospital car park, then to Tomas Renn over a cup of tea. **AND RENN'S ANSWER IS THE CARD'S MAJOR TURN AND IT IS NOT IMPROVED BY ANYBODY: IT IS THE FIRST TIME ANYBODY HAS SAID THAT SENTENCE TO HIM BEFORE BEING ASKED, IN NINE MONTHS, HE HAS BEEN ON THE OTHER SIDE OF IT ABOUT NINE TIMES, HE HAS NEVER ONCE BEEN TOLD IN ADVANCE, AND EVERY SINGLE TIME HE HAS GOT IT RIGHT AND EVERY SINGLE TIME IT HAS COST HIM THE WHOLE OF THE EVENING GETTING IT RIGHT ON HIS OWN IN A CORRIDOR FIRST.**

**SANAA IQBAL'S BOUNDARY WAS SAID IN A DOORWAY AT ABOUT HALF PAST SIX IN THE MORNING ON SUNDAY 29 NOVEMBER, IN ADVANCE, ON THE MORNING OF THE BOAT: SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE FIXED, SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE THE REASON ANYBODY IS TALKED OUT OF ANYTHING OR TALKED IN TO ANYTHING, AND IF SHE FINDS OUT IN THREE WEEKS THAT EITHER OF THOSE THINGS HAPPENED SHE WILL BE EXTREMELY UNPLEASANT ABOUT IT AND HE CAN PUT IT IN THE LETTER; AND SHE IS GOING BECAUSE THERE IS A BOAT AT TEN PAST SEVEN AND FOUR OF THEM ARE ON IT AND A ROOM ON THE FRIDAY, AND SHE WOULD HAVE GOT IN THAT BOAT IF THERE HAD BEEN THREE OF THEM AND SHE WOULD HAVE GOT IN IT IF THERE HAD BEEN FIVE, AND THERE IS NOT A SECOND REASON UNDERNEATH IT.** He did not argue with it in a doorway at half past six in the morning. **IT WAS NOT A QUARREL AND NONE OF THE FOUR IMPROVED IT AND THEY ARE NOT REPAIRED AND NOTHING ABOUT THE TWO OF THEM WHO STOPPED ARGUING IN SEPTEMBER IS FIXED IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS, AND THE FACT THAT SHE WAS ON THE BOAT IS A FACT ABOUT THE BOAT AND THE WORK. HER TWENTY MINUTES A WEEK AND THE COMPLIANCE PARAGRAPH BEHIND IT ARE UNTOUCHED AND PARAGRAPH 4.11 IS NOT ANSWERED.**

**THE FOUR OF THEM WERE JONAS MERCER, TOMAS RENN, NELL ARDENT AND SANAA IQBAL AND THEY HAD NOT BEEN IN A ROOM TOGETHER SINCE THE MIDDLE OF SEPTEMBER, WHEN TWO OF THEM ARGUED IN FRONT OF ABOUT THIRTY PEOPLE AND STOPPED AND NEITHER OF THEM DECIDED TO STOP.** Nell Ardent was sick over the side at about a quarter of the way over and said *Don't* and was told *I wasn't going to*. Renn made Jonas tell him about the eleventh of November on the boat. Ardent said she had two questions for the room and a third one she would not be asking, because she has no standing in that room and neither has anybody else on the boat, and said *I would like it minuted that I read it*, and it is not minuted. They landed at about ten past eight at a slip in Ravensmere past a bridge, and a man in a peaked cap told them the works was the second one past the bridge.

**AND THE UNANSWERED THING THIS OPENED: NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH — NOT JONAS MERCER, NOT NELL ARDENT, NOT TOMAS RENN — HAS WORKED OUT HOW A STANDING GROUP OF THREE AUTHORITIES IN ANOTHER CITY HEARD OF A SHEET OF TWO PAGES THAT WENT DOWN ON A COUNTER BY THE WATER IN FRONT OF SIX PEOPLE ON 30 SEPTEMBER 2015 AND WENT BACK ACROSS THE ESTUARY IN A PLASTIC WALLET. NELL ARDENT HAD ALSO BEEN SENT A COPY BY SOMEBODY SHE COULD NOT IDENTIFY AND IS NOT GOING TO TRY. THE PERMISSION FROM ALDERWICK IS THE REASON THAT LETTER EXISTS AND IT IS NOT WORKED OUT, AND IT IS NOT A TWELFTH REFUSAL AND NOT A FINDING AND NOT A SCANDAL, AND IT IS OPEN.**

## 4. THE FIRST REGIONAL SYSTEM, AND THE TWO LINES, AND THE BARGAIN IT REFLECTS

**ON FRIDAY 4 DECEMBER 2015 JONAS MERCER SPENT FOUR HOURS IN THE FIRST OF THE THREE REGIONAL SYSTEMS AND IT IS THE BEST-RUN PUBLIC THING HE HAS EVER STOOD INSIDE.** Ravensmere takes water off an intake, filters it, and delivers it to three towns. The works was built before anybody in that room was born, the filters were renewed some years back and the bill went down when they were, the pressure at the far end of the third town is good enough that the man who runs the clinic there has not had to ask for a tank in nine years, and a standpipe at the edge of the second town costs a person nothing and asks nothing of them. **AND EVERY PART OF IT IS HELD BY SOMEBODY PRIVATELY: IN THE FIRST TOWN THE WORKS IS A COMPANY'S, IN THE SECOND THE MAINS ARE A TRUST'S, IN THE THIRD ONE PUMPING STATION IS MUNICIPAL AND THE OTHER TWO ARE NOT, AND THE TWO THAT ARE NOT HAVE BOTH CHANGED HANDS INSIDE TEN YEARS, AND EVERY TIME ONE CHANGED HANDS NOTHING WAS BROKEN AND NOTHING WAS PROMISED AND THE OBLIGATIONS STAYED EXACTLY WHERE THEY WERE. THE GROUP IS THREE AUTHORITIES AND ABOUT SIX STAFF.**

**NOBODY IN IT IS A VILLAIN AND NOBODY IS HIDING ANYTHING AND EVERY SENTENCE ISELIN KROGH SAYS IS RIGHT.** She said the word *deliberate* out loud. She said nothing in the arrangement asks a person to give anything up. She said nothing about it is secret, and the terms are on the wall, and the office hands a copy to anybody who walks in and asks for one, and there is no charge for it and no record of who has taken one — **AND JONAS MERCER WAS THE ONLY PERSON WHO ASKED FOR ONE IN THREE WEEKS, AND IT IS IN A PLASTIC WALLET IN HIS INSIDE COAT POCKET, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING HE HAS BROUGHT HOME FROM ANOTHER CITY IN THIS ACCOUNT AND IT COST HIM NOTHING.**

**AND THE SHEET IS THE FINDING. IT IS A GOOD SHEET AND IT SAYS THIS, AT THE BOTTOM, IN THE SAME TYPE, THE SAME SIZE, WITH THE SAME SPACE ABOVE EACH:**

> *Nothing is required of any person in order to use any part of this system.*
> *A person has no standing in respect of anything recorded under this.*

**A PERSON IS NOT REQUIRED TO GIVE ANYTHING UP TO USE IT, AND A PERSON CANNOT DO ANYTHING ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS TO WHAT THEY HAVE GIVEN, AND BOTH OF THOSE ARE IN THE SAME TWO LINES. THERE IS NOTHING BETWEEN THEM. THE CORRIDOR SHEET IN RAVENSMERE CARRIES ONLY THE FIRST LINE; THE FULL SHEET IN THE OFFICE CARRIES BOTH; BOTH CARRY THE DATE THE FILTERS WERE DONE IN A FOOTNOTE; AND THE WALL ONE HAS HAD A LINE TAKEN OFF IT AND HAS NOT BEEN LEFT BLANK.**

**AND A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-ONE, WHO COMES TO A CANTEEN HATCH AT TEN TO THREE ON FRIDAYS IN THIS CITY AND IS ON NOTHING AND IS NOT A PARTY TO ANYTHING, PUT THOSE TWO FACTS NEXT TO EACH OTHER IN THAT CORRIDOR AND THEN WISHED HE HAD NOT.** He had crossed on a Friday boat and gone back on a Sunday four times since August and had not told anybody. He said: *That's two lines.* And: *I'd rather I hadn't said that. Not because it's wrong. Because I've just said the only thing anybody's said about that wall in about ten years and I'm in a corridor, and I don't know who heard it, and I can't un-say it, and I'm going to have to go back into that room in twenty minutes and sit down.* He said it, went back in, and said nothing else for the rest of the morning. **HE IS THE SAME MAN AS THE ONE IN 0201 AND 0202 AND IS NOT A SECOND OF HIM AND IS NOT RE-AGED. HE IS NOT A THREAD AND HE IS OWED NOTHING.**

## 5. THE SECOND PART OF THE SAME SYSTEM, AND A PERSON PAID BY TWO PLACES

**ON WEDNESDAY 9 DECEMBER 2015 THERE IS A ROOM ON THE SECOND FLOOR AT RAVENSMERE WITH A TIN ON THE TABLE, AND ON THE SECOND WEDNESDAY OF EVERY MONTH PEOPLE COME INTO IT AND ARE PAID IN ENVELOPES AND INITIAL A CORNER OF A SHEET, AND THE MONEY IS IN THE ENVELOPE BEFORE THE WORK, WHICH IS NOT A FAVOUR AND IS THE CONDITION OF THE WHOLE ARRANGEMENT.**

**A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-NINE IS ONE OF THE NINE NAMES ON THE SCHEDULE OF THE PERMISSION OF 30 SEPTEMBER 2015 — THE LAST NAME ON IT, WHOSE ROW IS A NAME WITH THIS CITY UNDER IT — AND HE WAS NEVER ASKED WHY HE IS NOT ON THE SHEET THAT CAME BACK, AND NOBODY IN THIS CITY HAS ASKED.** He has a job at a pumping station in this city, in Tideglass, four days a week, on the distribution side of the estuary, doing the work of two men. **HE IS BEING PAID BY A CITY ACROSS THE WATER, IN AN ENVELOPE, AT THAT CITY'S RATE, WHICH IS NOT THE RATE THE SAME WORK IS PAID AT ON HIS SIDE OF THE WATER, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS NOT SMALL, AND HE CROSSES THE ESTUARY ON THE PAY DAY TO BE PAID, AND HE HAS DONE IT FOUR TIMES SINCE SEPTEMBER AND WILL DO IT IN JANUARY.**

**BOTH CITIES CALL IT SOMETHING DIFFERENT AND HE IS THE ONLY PERSON IN THE WORLD WHO KNOWS THE DIFFERENCE.** The water undertaker in this city calls it a **relief contract**. Ravensmere's sheet calls it an **attachment**, and defines an attached man as a man attached to the works. **NOBODY IN THIS CITY COULD PRODUCE EITHER PIECE OF WRITING EVEN IF THEY WERE ASKED, BECAUSE THE PERMISSION IS IN A PLASTIC WALLET IN A CITY ON THE OTHER SIDE OF AN ESTUARY AND THE ATTACHMENT SHEET IS IN A CORRIDOR IN ANOTHER CITY, AND WHAT HE HAS IS A NAME ON A SHEET IN EACH PLACE.** He said, to nobody in particular, that he has got a house and a road and a bed about two miles from where he stood at seven o'clock that morning and is attached to a works on the other side of an estuary that he has never once been asked inside.

**JONAS MERCER STOOD IN THE CORRIDOR, COULD HAVE ASKED HIM ONE QUESTION, AND DID NOT. HE IS THE ONLY PERSON IN EITHER CITY WHO COULD HAVE, BECAUSE HE IS THE ONLY PERSON WHO HAS READ BOTH OF THE TWO WORDS. HE IS NOT GOING TO. THE ARRANGEMENT IS IN WRITING AND THE WRITING IS CORRECT. THE ENVELOPE WAS STILL SEALED WHEN THE MAN WENT DOWN IN THE LIFT AT ABOUT FOUR O'CLOCK AND THEY DID NOT EXCHANGE ANOTHER WORD.**

**AND THE GROUP'S OWN AFTERNOON ITEM ON THE NINTH, WHICH HE WAS IN THE CORRIDOR FOR AND DID NOT HEAR, WAS TWO DOCUMENTS BOTH CORRECT AND BOTH TAKEN FROM THAT PERMISSION: THE NUMBER OF PEOPLE THE ARRANGEMENT HAD MOVED, WHICH IS SIX, AND THE SIX DATES ON A SHEET IN A DUTY CLERK'S BAG; AND THE SENTENCE ABOUT WHERE A CLAIM ARISING OUT OF THE WORK IS MADE, WHICH ISELIN KROGH READ OUT IN THE VOICE SHE USES FOR THINGS THAT ARE ALREADY SETTLED, AND NOBODY ARGUED WITH IT, AND THE MINUTE SAYS THE ITEM WAS NOTED. A PRICED-ACCESS CASE IS NOT A RECOGNITION CASE. A DUTY IS AN ACT AND NOT A PLACE AND MAY NOT BECOME A WAY OF MAKING A STREET FINDABLE. A PERSON WHO IS NOT COUNTED IS NOT A PERSON WHO IS HELPED AND NOTHING IN THIS BATCH REFUTED THAT.**

## 6. THE CORRIDOR, AND THE SENTENCE, AND ITS STANDING

**ON TUESDAY 15 DECEMBER 2015, AFTER AN HOUR OF ORDINARY ARGUMENT ABOUT STANDPIPE HOURS THAT SETTLED ON SEVEN IN THE MORNING TO EIGHT IN THE EVENING — WHICH IS NOBODY'S NUMBER — ISELIN KROGH CAME OUT OF THE ROOM AND SAID THE TRUE THING ABOUT THE BARGAIN INTO A CORRIDOR, TO ONE PERSON, COULD NOT FINISH THE SENTENCE, SAID IT ANYWAY, AND THEN SAID SHE SHOULD NOT HAVE SAID IT, AND IT WAS NOT TAKEN BACK.**

**WHAT SHE SAID, IN THE FORM 0211 GIVES IT, IS THE CANON OF THE FIRST REGIONAL SYSTEM AND IT MAY NOT BE SOFTENED:** it is not a bargain between two things; it is an agreement between three of them and a great many people outside that building that the part everybody is responsible for will always be the part somebody owns; the obligations were written first, the ownership came afterwards in pieces over a generation in rooms she was not in; nobody has had to do anything wrong for any of that to happen, and nobody in that room has done anything wrong, and every part fits, and the water is good, and the standpipe runs, and the filters were done on time — **and the result of it, which nobody has ever put in a sentence in that room, is that the whole of the part of this that three towns are answerable for is the part that nobody owns, and the part nobody owns is the part that gets sold.** She could not finish it because the next part of that sentence is the part she cannot say, and because in that room the sentence is an accusation and it is not an accusation and there is no way of putting it in that room that it does not come out as one, and she has been in that building nineteen years and has stopped looking for a way round it.

**SHE SAID IT BECAUSE THE MAN SHE SAID IT TO HAS NO STANDING, NO OFFICE, NO DEPARTMENT AND NO BODY BEHIND HIM, AND SHE SAID THAT OUT LOUD. JONAS MERCER SAID NOTHING AT ALL, AND THE NOTEBOOK IN THE INSIDE POCKET OF HIS COAT STAYED IN THE INSIDE POCKET OF HIS COAT, AND ON THE FRIDAY MORNING NELL ARDENT SAID *YOU'VE BEEN IN THAT BUILDING TWICE. WHAT IS WRONG WITH IT* AND HE SAID *NOTHING'S WRONG WITH IT. THE WATER'S GOOD*, AND SHE LOOKED AT HIM FOR SLIGHTLY TOO LONG AND WENT BACK TO HER PAPER, AND IT STAYED IN THE CORRIDOR WHERE SHE PUT IT.**

**THE STANDING OF THAT SENTENCE IN THIS ACCOUNT IS EXACTLY THE STANDING OF A SENTENCE SAID ONCE ON A PAVEMENT IN SEPTEMBER: IT WAS SAID ONCE, IT IS NOT WRITTEN DOWN, IT IS NOT REPEATED, IT IS NOT MINUTED, IT IS NOT IN A REPORT, IT IS NOT IN ANY OF THE STATE FILES AS A THING ANYBODY DID, AND IT IS CARRIED AS A THING THAT HAPPENED TO A PERSON AND NOT AS A PARAGRAPH.** Nobody was given authority and nobody's sentence improved.

## 7. AN ORDINARY DAY, AND THE THIRD TIME

**ON SUNDAY 20 DECEMBER 2015, IN A CITY THAT IS NOT THIS ONE, WITH NOTHING IN THE REGIONAL SYSTEM HAVING ANYTHING TO DO WITH HIM AND NOBODY HAVING ARRANGED THAT IT WOULD, TWO SMALL CORRECT THINGS HAPPENED ON ONE AFTERNOON, AND NEITHER PERSON WAS ON ANYTHING, AND NOBODY FOUND OUT, AND THE ONLY PERSON WHO KNOWS BOTH OF THEM HAPPENED IS THE PERSON WHO WALKED DOWN THE SAME STREET TWICE.**

- **THE FIRST, AT ABOUT TWENTY PAST TWO, IN A QUEUE OUTSIDE A CHEMIST'S: A MAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-FOUR, THIRD FROM THE FRONT, WITH A BASKET, WAS RIGHT ABOUT A BAD LABEL.** The window showed a smaller bottle at ninety-one pence and the shelf a larger one at a pound four; he was wrong about the bottle and right about the label, said *put a card on the big one*, was told the shop does not do cards on a Sunday, said *then do it on a Monday and do it before anybody's paid*, and was told *I'll put a label in, I can't do a card*, to which he said *a label's a card with a price on it*. He took the small bottle for the small money. **THE CHEMIST WROTE A NOTE ON THE BACK OF HER HAND AND PUT THE BOTTLE SOMEWHERE ELSE ON THE SHELF, WHICH IS A SYSTEM, AND IT IS THE WHOLE OF THE SYSTEM, AND A LABEL WENT IN ON THE MONDAY MORNING AT ABOUT TEN PAST NINE AND IT SAYS THE SAME AS THE WINDOW.**
- **THE SECOND, SMALLER, AT ABOUT TEN TO THREE, FOUR HUNDRED YARDS UP THE SAME STREET, AT A BUS SHELTER: A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-NINE WAS RIGHT ABOUT A TIMETABLE.** The four o'clock bus comes at ten to, has done since the Sunday service was changed, and nobody reprinted the timetable, and the board in the shelter and the sheet in a shop in the third town are not even out of the same year. **The driver has known since the change, does not say, and looks in the mirror once at about the second stop. She is not going to stand in a shelter and shout at a bus driver about a printed sheet on a Sunday, and the four o'clock is at ten to until somebody who owns the printing says different, and she has not got an idea who that is and neither has Jonas Mercer.**

**THEY WERE FOUR HUNDRED YARDS APART AND NEITHER KNEW ANYTHING ABOUT THE OTHER, AND HE TOLD NEITHER OF THEM ANYTHING.** **AND THIS IS THE THIRD TIME SINCE THE PUMP AT THE BOTTOM OF PEVERELL STREET THAT A CORRECT THING HAS BEEN DONE IN A STREET BY SOMEBODY WHO IS ON NOTHING AND NOTHING HAS COME OF IT, THE FIRST BEING A DOORWAY KEPT DRY WITH A PUMP BY A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SEVEN IN SEPTEMBER, THE SECOND BEING A GULLY CLEARED WITH A BAR BY A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FOUR AND A WOMAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-FIVE ON 10 NOVEMBER, AND THE THIRD BEING THESE TWO, AND 0212 NAMES THE FIRST TWO IN ITS OWN HEAD SO THAT THE COUNT IS TRUE ON THE PAGE AND NOT ONLY HERE.** **THE THREE ARE DONE BY THREE SEPARATE SETS OF PEOPLE AND A REVIEW CAUGHT ONE STATE FILE MERGING THE SECOND INTO THE FIRST; THE PUMP AND THE DOORWAY BELONG TO THE MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SEVEN AND THE GULLY AND THE BAR BELONG TO THE MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FOUR AND THE WOMAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-FIVE, AND NEITHER MAY BE ATTRIBUTED TO THE OTHER.**

## 8. THE CLAIM THAT CAME BACK, AND THE TWO OF THEM IN TWO CITIES

**ON SATURDAY 26 DECEMBER 2015, ON A SIGNED-FOR BUNDLE AT A RECORDS DESK IN A BUILDING BY THE WATER IN THIS CITY, A CLAIM ARRIVED. IT IS CORRECT. IT ARRIVED IN AN ORDINARY WAY. IT IS ABOUT MONEY. AND THE CLAUSE THAT SENT IT IS THE SIXTH.**

- It is one sheet, dated **11 December 2015**, carrying the same reference as the permission, headed as a claim made under the mutual-aid permission of the thirtieth of September 2015 and made in the city in which the work was done. It is addressed to the water office, which is two floors up and had gone for Christmas.
- It names **one man, who is about twenty**, and says he was employed for **fourteen days in October** under that permission at a pumping station on the north bank at **Alderwick**, and that on the last day of that fortnight he was injured, and that the injury is described in two lines, and that a sum is claimed. The sum is not large. It is about what a man of that age costs to keep for about a month.
- **THE SIXTH CLAUSE SAYS A CLAIM ARISING OUT OF WORK DONE UNDER THE PERMISSION IS MADE IN THE CITY WHERE THE WORK WAS DONE AND NOT IN THE CITY THE PERSON CAME FROM. THE CLAIM IS MADE IN ALDERWICK. THE CLAIM IS CORRECTLY MADE. IT HAS COME TO TIDEGLASS, WHICH IS THE CITY THAT GRANTED THE PERMISSION AND THE CITY THE PERSON CAME FROM, AND IT CANNOT BE DEALT WITH HERE.**
- It went into a tray under a window on Nina Calder's desk, which is a tray and is not a register, and it will be picked up on the Monday by whoever signs for the water office and will go into a pile, and the pile is not anywhere anybody looks, and the woman from the water office could come down and take it upstairs herself and do something perfectly good with it, and there is no way of telling Jonas Mercer which of those two will happen and that is why he can only say *put it in the tray*.

**AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH CAN TELL WHETHER IT IS A PRICE, A RECEIPT OR A PRECEDENT, AND ALL THREE READINGS ARE TRUE AND ARE NOT THE SAME SHAPE.** A price, because the first thing to come back along a piece of paper to a city that handed something out for nothing is a bill. A receipt, because six people in this city took fourteen days across the estuary in October, were paid in an envelope before the work, all six came home on the dates on a sheet, one of the six has since had a claim made about him, and there is nothing in this borough that could tell those two things apart. A precedent, because it is the first one, and it asks the authority that granted the permission for the sum, and if this borough answers it then it has agreed that the permission runs backwards as well as forwards, and if it does not answer it then a man of about twenty who worked a fortnight at a pumping station and came home has not got anybody. **AND THE BOROUGH HAS NO INSTRUMENT FOR CHOOSING, BECAUSE A BODY THAT CANNOT REQUIRE ANYBODY TO DO ANYTHING CANNOT BE TOLD WHAT IT WILL DO, AND BECAUSE THE TWO PEOPLE WITH A DEPARTMENT ARE NOT GOING TO WRITE ANYTHING DOWN THIS CHRISTMAS, AND BECAUSE THE WOMAN IN ANOTHER CITY HAS ONE OF HER OWN AND IS NOT GOING TO BE ASKED BY ANYBODY TO PUT HERS NEXT TO THIS ONE.**

**JONAS MERCER WAS THE FIRST PERSON TO SEE WHAT IT WAS AND HE DID NOT SAY SO AND HE DID NOT GO AND FIND THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY, WHO WAS AT A FOOTBALL MATCH IN THIS CITY THAT AFTERNOON WITH ABOUT EIGHT HUNDRED OTHER PEOPLE. THAT AFTERNOON HE TELEPHONED RAVENSMERE AND ISELIN KROGH SAID, BEFORE HE HAD GOT TO ANYTHING, THAT SHE HAD HAD A LETTER WITH THE SAME REFERENCE ON IT ON THE EIGHTEENTH AND HAD PUT IT IN A FOLDER IN A DRAWER; HE ASKED HER WHAT IT WAS; SHE SAID *I AM NOT GOING TO SAY THAT ON A TELEPHONE* AND HE SAID HE HAD A LETTER AS WELL. NEITHER OF THEM SAID WHAT EITHER OF THEM HAD. BY THE TIME SOMEBODY ELSE KNEW WHAT IT WAS THERE WERE TWO OF THEM IN TWO CITIES, AND THERE IS NO DOCUMENT IN EITHER OF THOSE TWO CITIES THAT SAYS THAT EITHER OF THEM KNEW.**

**THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-SEVEN IS NOT THE MAN THIS IS ABOUT. HE DOES NOT APPEAR IN 0213 AT ALL AND MAY NOT BE PUT IN ONE SENTENCE, ONE LIST OR ONE ROOM WITH THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY OR WITH Ewen Ashgrove, WHO ALSO APPEARS NOWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS.**

## 9. THE LAST EVENING, AND THE TWO DOCUMENTS, AND WHAT IS STILL OPEN

**ON WEDNESDAY 30 DECEMBER 2015 AT ABOUT SEVEN IN THE EVENING, IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP IN RAVENSMERE, WITH JONAS MERCER, NELL ARDENT AND SANAA IQBAL, THE BATCH'S QUESTION WAS RESTATED AS A FACT ABOUT TWO PIECES OF PAPER HELD IN TWO HANDS AND IT WAS NOT ANSWERED AND IT IS NOT ANSWERED NOW.**

- **In Jonas Mercer's hand, in a plastic wallet:** the full sheet from the works office, given to him on 4 December, no charge, no record of who has taken one.
- **In Nell Ardent's hand:** two sheets in her own writing, the first copied off the corridor wall sheet, the second off the office sheet, compared with a ruler, on the same table, with the group's printed agenda for 4 December beside them and a fourth sheet empty.
- **The wall sheet carries one line. The office sheet carries two. The second line on the office sheet is *A person has no standing in respect of anything recorded under this.* The short sheet has not been left blank, it has had a line taken off it, and the four inches underneath are white and they are not white because there was nothing there.**

SARN AGGREGATES, on a weighbridge, from a man who has been on it a long time and keeps a kettle in a hut: depends entirely on the work; they have never turned a job away in twenty years, not one, not for anybody, not for a reason; if the borough's men stop coming over they lose a bit and the price goes with the work and they go and find the work, and they are not a party to anything he does with his Tuesday; and there is no book there with the borough's name in it that anybody ever asked them to keep, a docket is where it went and how much. LOWDALE HIRE, in a cabin, from a man who says he said all of it in the March to a woman at that window and got the Tuesday out of it and that if he has come to ask again he has come for nothing: half his turnover in this borough is work that leaves it on a Sunday and comes back on the Sunday after because the same crews take it out again the following week; that is what a Tuesday is; nobody sat down and made a Tuesday; a Tuesday is a bunch of vans going out and coming back and him putting fuel in them, and if the vans stop he gets a quiet week, and if the vans go somewhere else entirely and he never finds out, he still gets the fuel; and there is no blood in it anywhere and he wishes there was, because he would charge more. MARCMONT, at a forecourt on a post by the gate, from a man who reads the price card out to anybody in about four seconds and puts the card straight afterwards: more, they could double, there is four counties' worth of road in that region and a week on a Tuesday is nothing; to whoever walks in; nobody is coming here to be loyal to a borough, and you want a supplier that is loyal, you want a family.**

**THE MAJOR TURN, AND IT IS THE CARD'S TURN: A REGION CAN BE MADE TO GO SLOW BY A SUPPLY CHAIN THAT IS BEING POLITE, AND THE ONLY THINGS IT COSTS ARE A NOTEBOOK AND A WEEK ON A TUESDAY, AND THE PEOPLE WHO WOULD ENJOY IT ARE PEOPLE THIS BOROUGH HAS NEVER MET AND WHO HAVE DONE NOTHING AND WILL HAVE DONE NOTHING. NONE OF THE FOUR IS WITHHOLDING ANYTHING AND NONE OF THEM CAN BE, BECAUSE NONE OF THEM HAS EVER BEEN ASKED A QUESTION. THE WOMAN ON THE CORRANCE COUNTER HAS THE RATE ON A BOARD ON THE SHELF BEHIND HER AND HAS NEVER READ IT AND SAYS SO, AND THE MAN IN THE LOWDALE CABIN SAID IT ALL ONCE IN FEBRUARY.**

**JONAS MERCER WROTE THE LOWDALE MAN'S WORDS DOWN IN HIS OWN HAND, ABOUT A HUNDRED AND THIRTY WORDS, ON THE PAGE AT THE BACK OF THE NOTEBOOK THAT HAS BEEN IN HIS INSIDE POCKET SINCE THE SUMMER, AND NONE OF IT WAS A COMPLAINT. HE GAVE THAT NOTEBOOK AWAY ON THE ELEVENTH OF MAY AND THE GIVING IS THE PRICE OF WHAT HE DID NEXT.**

## 4. A RIGHT OF RETURN, AND THE THING THAT MAKES IT ONE

**ON FRIDAY 6 MAY 2016 IN that first floor room, AND IT IS ALL OF CARD 0238 AND IT IS NOW CANON. THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FIVE WHO HAS THAT ROOM WAS IN ON A FRIDAY, AS SHE IS NOT ON A SUNDAY FOR ANYBODY, AND THE FINDING ARRIVED BY HER WRITING DOWN HIS DRAFTS AND REJECTING THEM.**

**AND THE CHAPTER DOES NOT SAY THE SUMMATION ANYWHERE, AND NEITHER DOES ANYBODY IN IT. WHAT SHE DOES IS REFUSE THE QUESTION HE ASKED. HE ASKED FOR THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A PERMISSION AND A RIGHT OF RETURN AND SHE SAID: it's a permission, that's the word for it if you want one in a hurry, and it is the wrong one. WHEN HE SAID THAT ISN'T AN ANSWER SHE SAID: you have asked me how many ways a person is allowed to do a thing, and that is the same question about both of them, and they will give you the same answer, and you would take that as proof they are the same and you would be right to, and you would be no use whatsoever. SO ASK ME THE OTHER HALF. NOT WHAT A PERSON MAY DO. WHAT HAPPENS TO THE PERSON WHO DOES IT.**

**HE WROTE THREE ON THE BACK OF HIS HAND WITH HER BIRO AND SHE READ THEM UPSIDE DOWN, WHICH IS FASTER AND IS WHAT SHE DOES. (1) *If anybody in this borough does any work again, it may be done by anybody, and the person who does it may come back.* — THAT IS A PERMISSION WITH A BAD END ON IT, AND A PERMISSION IS WHAT YOU WRITE FOR A THING THAT HAS ALREADY BEEN DECIDED. (2) *If a crew goes out of this borough and comes back into it, it will be sent to what this borough needs first.* — THAT IS A ROTA, AND A ROTA WITH NO NAME ON IT YET IS WORSE, BECAUSE IT IS A ROTA WAITING FOR SOMEBODY TO FILL IT IN, AND THE SOMEBODY WHO FILLS IT IN IS THE BOSS. (3) *Anybody in this borough can be asked, in advance, to be at a place they are not at now.* — SHE DID NOT READ THAT ONE OUT LOUD. **THAT'S A DUTY. DON'T.** AND WHEN HE SAID ALL THREE ARE NOTHING: no, all three of them are something, and all three of them are worse than nothing, and that is the answer, and it took four minutes and a biro. THE OTHER HALF IS WHY THERE IS NOTHING TO WRITE: if you write it, it is a form, and a form has got a box on it, and the box has got a person in it, and then you are back to the corridor and the name under the line; and if you do not write it, anybody can pick it up and do whatever they like with it, and in this borough that is the same as it being true, because the only thing that has ever held anything up here for any length of time is a thing nobody could pin to anybody.**

**AND THE PROOF, WHICH IS A DOORWAY FOUR DOORS UP THE STREET FROM THE BOARD, AND HE ASKED THE MAN IN IT NOTHING AT ALL. THERE IS THE PUMP, ON A STANDPIPE A MAN PUT IN HIMSELF, AND A HOSE COILED ON THE WALL THAT HAS NOT BEEN TOUCHED SINCE THE WATER WENT DOWN, AND THE DOOR IS ALWAYS OPEN A HAND'S WIDTH, AND THE MAN WAS INSIDE DOING SOMETHING WITH A RADIO. HE STOOD THERE ABOUT TWO MINUTES AND DID NOT ASK HIM ANYTHING, AND THAT WAS THE WHOLE OF WHAT HE DID ON THAT AFTERNOON, AND THE FINDING HE CARRIED BACK UP THE PARADE IS: **THE THING THAT MAKES A RETURN A RIGHT RATHER THAN A FAVOUR IS SOMEBODY BEING THERE WHEN IT IS NEEDED, AND THAT IS A THING TO BE ASKED FOR AND NOT A THING TO BE PROMISED IN ADVANCE.** YOU CAN ONLY ASK SOMEBODY ON THE DAY, AND IF YOU ASK THEM IN ADVANCE YOU HAVE MADE A ROTA ROW, AND THE FIRST PERSON IN THAT ROW WOULD BE TOMAS RENN, AND THE LAST TIME SOMEBODY MADE A LIST OF THIS BOROUGH'S CREWS IT WENT TO A COUNTY IN A POST. A RIGHT OF RETURN IS NOT A LANE ANYBODY LIVES IN AND NOT A WAY OF MAKING A STREET FINDABLE, AND THE CHAPTER SAYS NEITHER OF THOSE SENTENCES OUT LOUD.**

**THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FIVE ALSO SAYS THE ONE THING SHE HAS SAID TO HERSELF IN THAT ROOM, AND IT IS ABOUT A SHEET ON A WALL IN A TOWN UP THE ESTUARY WITH FOUR LINES ON IT AND A MAN'S NAME UNDER THE SECOND ONE, AND ONE OF THOSE FOUR SAYS THAT WHAT HE HOLDS IS A THING HE DOES AND NOT A PLACE HE STANDS IN, AND IT HAS BEEN ON THAT WALL TWENTY-TWO YEARS AND HAS NOT BEEN REPRINTED, AND SHE SAYS SHE HAS HAD THAT SENTENCE IN HER HEAD SINCE BEFORE CHRISTMAS, AND IT IS TRUE AND IT DOES NOT HELP HER BY ONE THING, BECAUSE A MAN WHO IS TOLD TO BE SOMEWHERE HAS BEEN GIVEN A PLACE.**

## 9. THE SHEET, THE EIGHT TOWNS, AND THE WIDER CIVIC EXPERIMENT

THE LINE SAYS, WORD FOR WORD, THE LINE THAT IS FRAMED ON THE WALL BY THE OFFICE DOOR AT PENHALE: *any part of any system in this region may be used by any person.* **AND IT MAY NOT BE SAID THAT IT CARRIES A CHARTER, A PROXY, A ROOT TERM, A HINGE, A SEAL, A DATE OF ORIGIN, A NAME OF A BODY, A MECHANISM OR AN EXPLANATION, AND IT DOES NOT, AND IT IS NOT A DOCUMENT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH COULD ACT ON.***

**THE EIGHT PLACES ARE TOWNS AND THEY ARE: NETHERBY, TOLFORT, HALSE CROSS, ANSTERWICK, KIRKMOSS, ELLERSBY, MARLEBY AND OCKBROOK. THE WOMAN WHO HAS BEEN IN THE METHODIST HALL ON CARROW LANE ABOUT TWO YEARS READS THEM OUT TWICE IN 0244 AND KNOWS EXACTLY ONE OF THEM, AND OOKBROOK'S IS ON THE WAY TO HER SISTER'S, AND SHE COULD NOT POINT AT IT, AND THE REST SHE COULD NOT TELL YOU IF YOU PAID HER.**

**THE MAJOR TURN, AND IT IS THE CARD'S TURN AND IT IS THE WIDER CIVIC EXPERIMENT: THE ARRANGEMENT PENHALE RUNS ON WAS NOT THE FIRST OF ITS KIND AND WAS NOT THE ONLY ONE, AND IT IS REVEALED BY A LIST OF PLACE NAMES AND BY NOTHING ELSE. HANNA WRAY READ IT STANDING UP TWICE AND DID NOT SIT DOWN, AND SAID: that's the same six inches of type, that's off a machine that somebody else set, it's the same as the wall in the hut and it is the same as the thing on a corridor in the city on the far side of the water that the woman with the bag has got two of in her own handwriting, and that is a fact about printing and not about anything else. IT'S THE SAME SENTENCE. IT'S NOT THE SAME SHEET. THE ONE ON THE WALL AT PENHALE HAS GOT A SECOND LINE UNDER IT AND NOBODY PRINTS THE SECOND LINE. AND THIS ONE'S GOT EIGHT TOWNS UNDER IT AND NOBODY PRINTED A WORD ABOUT A SINGLE ONE OF THEM. IT DOES NOT SAY WHEN IT STARTED AND IT DOES NOT SAY WHO SET IT AND IT IS NOT SIGNED AT THE BOTTOM AND IT DOES NOT SAY WHAT IT IS FOR, AND IF YOU RANG THE NUMBER ON THE BACK OF THE TIMETABLE IN THAT SHELTER YOU WOULD NOT GET ANYBODY WHO COULD TELL YOU WHAT TO DO WITH IT. **IT IS NOT LOST AND IT IS NOT MISLAID AND THERE IS NOBODY TO SEND IT TO AND IT HAS NOT BEEN STOLEN AND THERE IS NOBODY ANYBODY CAN RING, AND THAT IS FOUR THINGS A LOST THING USUALLY IS AND IT IS NONE OF THEM.***

**IT WENT IN A DRAWER UNDER THE TRADE COUNTER AT THE BACK OF THE SHOP ON THE PARADE, FACE UP, ON TOP OF A DOCKET FROM THE WEEK BEFORE, AND THAT DRAWER HAS A LOCK ON IT AND HANNA WRAY HAS THE ONLY KEY AND HAS NEVER ONCE GIVEN IT TO ANYBODY. IT CAME OUT ONCE, ON THE FOURTH OF JUNE, ONTO A TABLE IN A METHODIST HALL, AND WENT BACK IN AT TEN PAST FIVE WITH THE LOCK TURNED TWICE. **NOBODY HAS OPENED IT FURTHER THAN IT WAS OPENED.***

**AND THE SHAPE OF THE THING, WHICH IS NOW IN THE ROOM AND WHICH NOBODY PUTS SIDE BY SIDE. FIVE WORDS FOR THIS: A PERMISSION, AN OBLIGATION, A CLAIM, A COMPACT, A RIGHT OF RETURN. THE MAN IN HIS SIXTIES NAMES FOUR OF THEM — A PERMISSION, AN OBLIGATION, A CLAIM, A RIGHT OF RETURN — SAYS EVERY ONE OF THOSE FOUR IS A THING SOMEBODY COULD PUT A FINGER ON AND SHOW YOU, SAYS HE HAS READ ALL FOUR, AND THEN REFUSES, IN THESE WORDS, TO LAY THEM OUT ON A TABLE, BECAUSE THE LAST TIME ANYBODY LAID THEM OUT THEY MADE AN ARGUMENT OUT OF THEM THAT RESTED ON A DOCUMENT NOBODY CAN PRODUCE, AND HE HAS BEEN THE MAN WHO MADE THAT ARGUMENT AND HE HAS STOPPED. THE FIFTH, HE SAYS, IS A COMPACT, AND A COMPACT IS THE ONE YOU CANNOT POINT AT, AND THAT IS NOT A FLAW IN A COMPACT, THAT IS WHAT A COMPACT IS: two people putting a thing down and neither of them keeping a copy. THERE IS NOTHING IN A DRAWER WITH THIS BOROUGH'S NAMES ON IT, BECAUSE IF YOU KEPT A COPY YOU'D HAVE A FORM, AND IF YOU'VE GOT A FORM YOU'VE GOT A MANAGER, AND THEN THE THING'S STOPPED BEING TWO PEOPLE AND STARTED BEING AN OFFICE. AND THERE IS NOWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH AND NOWHERE IN ANY OF THOSE EIGHT TOWNS THAT ANYBODY COULD GO AND LAY A HAND ON IT. ## 12A. REVIEW REPAIR ON CHAPTERS 255–264, AND WHAT IT FOUND, AND WHAT WAS NOT A DEFECT

**A REVIEW OF THE CONTINUATION 0007 PHASE RAN ON 27 SEPTEMBER 2026. IT FOUND FOUR THINGS, THREE OF THEM IN THE HAND-OVER FILES AND ONE A FIGURE THAT NOBODY COULD REPRODUCE. NOT ONE OF THEM WAS IN THE PROSE: ALL TEN CHAPTERS WERE RE-MEASURED, AND THE WORD COUNTS, THE SCENE BREAKS, THE WEEKDAYS AGAINST THE REAL 2016 CALENDAR, THE GAPS, THE ALL-CAPS CAP, EVERY BANNED MOTIF, EVERY USE OF *FORTY*, THE ABSENCE OF THE WORD *THANK* AND OF THE STEM *REQUIR-*, AND BOTH DAY-COUNTS IN THE PROSE ALL REPRODUCED EXACTLY AS THE BATCH RECORDED THEM. NOT ONE CHAPTER FILE WAS EDITED IN THIS REPAIR AND NOT ONE CHAPTER WAS RESTARTED.**

**1. THE HEADLINE VERIFICATION CLAIM WAS FALSE, AND THE CLAIM WAS THE DEFECT RATHER THAN THE PROSE. §12 RECORDED THAT A SIX-GRAM DIFF OF ALL TWENTY ALL-CAPS BLOCKS AGAINST EVERY STATE, OUTLINE, BIBLE AND WORKSPACE FILE *RETURNED NOTHING*. IT DID NOT, AND IT NEVER COULD. A STATE FILE THAT SUMMARISES A CHAPTER HAS TO REPEAT THAT CHAPTER'S NOUNS AND ITS REGISTER, SO A SIX-GRAM DIFF OF THIS SHAPE IS GUARANTEED TO RETURN HUNDREDS OF MATCHES AND A CLEAN RESULT IS NOT A POSSIBLE OUTCOME. MEASURED ON CHAPTERS 255–264 AND THOSE CHAPTERS ALONE — A FIGURE OF 1,624 SIX-GRAMS AND 254 MATCHES IS ALSO IN CIRCULATION AND IS WRONG BY SCOPE, BECAUSE THAT RUN SWEPT IN 0250 TO 0254 — THE TWENTY BLOCKS HOLD 1,127 DISTINCT SIX-GRAMS AND 481 MATCHED THE STATE FILES AT THE TIME. THE CHECK WAS REPLACED WITH ONE THAT CAN FAIL: THE LONGEST VERBATIM SPAN, AT A THRESHOLD OF ELEVEN WORDS.**
